items.title: 再等恐付出更大代價！Fed反對票官員公開要求升息
items.title_en: Waiting Longer May Cost More! Fed Dissenters Publicly Call for Rate Hikes
paras: 本周反對聯準會 (Fed) 維持利率不變的 3 名官員周五 (31 日) 表示，現在就應採取升息行動，以防通膨進一步惡化，強調及早小幅調整政策，可避免日後被迫採取更激烈的緊縮措施。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 在聲明中表示，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 現在應該採取行動，加速個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數回到 2% 目標，履行維護物價穩定的承諾。她警告，通膨維持高檔的時間愈久，未來壓低通膨的難度與代價就愈高。
明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 也認為，現階段採取一連串小幅升息，會比持續等待、最終不得不祭出更大幅度行動來得理想。
卡什卡里與哈瑪克本周加入達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根 (Lorie Logan) 的行列，反對維持利率不變。FOMC 其餘 9 名具投票權官員則支持按兵不動，將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%。在 2025 年下半年連續降息 3 次後，Fed 今年以來始終未調整利率。
美國通膨超過 Fed 的 2% 目標已逾 5 年，今年又受到美伊戰爭及川普政府關稅政策影響而再度升溫。雖然中東緊張情勢短暫降溫，帶動 6 月物價漲勢放緩，但能源價格再度走高，市場擔心 Fed 最終仍須收緊貨幣政策。
Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 雖投票支持維持利率不變，但強調讓通膨回到目標的決心沒有動搖。他表示，長達 5 年多的通膨超標問題，不可能在 9 周內或僅憑單月物價小幅下降就獲得解決。
哈瑪克則直言，她沒有信心通膨會自行回落至目標。除了能源價格等供給面因素外，需求面也持續帶來物價壓力。克里夫蘭地區企業反映，漲價壓力正在擴大而非消退，消費者也對物價長期居高不下感到絕望。
卡什卡里表示，貨幣政策除了處理需求帶動的通膨，也應因應接連發生的供給衝擊，避免高通膨預期變得根深柢固。蘿根預計稍晚發表聲明，說明投下反對票的理由。
paras_en: Three Fed officials who voted against keeping rates unchanged this week said on Friday (the 31st) that the central bank should raise rates now to prevent inflation from worsening further, stressing that a modest early adjustment could avoid the need for more aggressive tightening later.

Beth Hammack, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, said in a statement that the Federal Open Market Committee should act now to accelerate the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index back toward its 2% target and fulfill its price‑stability mandate. She warned that the longer inflation stays high, the harder and more costly it will be to bring it down.

Neel Kashkari, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, also argued that a series of small rate hikes at this stage would be preferable to waiting and eventually being forced to take a larger‑scale action.

Kashkari and Hammack joined Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan this week in voting against holding rates steady. The other nine voting members of the FOMC supported keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.5%‑3.75%. After three consecutive cuts in the second half of 2025, the Fed has not changed rates at all this year.

U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% goal for more than five years and was reignited this year by the Israel‑Iran conflict and tariffs imposed by the Trump administration. Although Middle‑East tensions eased briefly, slowing June price gains, energy prices have risen again, prompting markets to worry that the Fed will ultimately have to tighten monetary policy.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who voted to keep rates unchanged, stressed that his resolve to bring inflation back to target remains firm. He said the more‑than‑five‑year period of elevated inflation cannot be solved in nine weeks or by a modest one‑month dip in prices.

Hammack said she lacks confidence that inflation will fall back to target on its own. In addition to supply‑side factors such as energy prices, demand‑side pressures continue to push prices up. Businesses in the Cleveland area report that price‑increase pressure is expanding rather than receding, and consumers are despairing over persistently high prices.

Kashkari added that monetary policy should address not only demand‑driven inflation but also the series of supply shocks, to prevent high‑inflation expectations from becoming entrenched. Logan is expected to issue a statement later explaining the reasons for her dissenting vote.

items.title: 特斯拉中國導入「豆包」大型語言模型 強化座艙在地化語音互動體驗
items.title_en: Tesla China Introduces ByteDance's "Doubao" Large Language Model to Enhance Localized In‑Cabin Voice Interaction
paras: 特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 中國 7 月 31 日公布了 2026.14.13 版本的車用軟體更新，涵蓋 Model 3、Model Y、Model S、Model X 車型，代表公司正式導入由字節跳動 (ByteDance) 開發的「豆包」大型語言模型 (LLM)。此舉被視為特斯拉強化中國市場在地化體驗、提升座艙競爭力的重要進展。
據指出，這項 AI 功能主要針對搭載 HW 3.0 或更早版本硬體的車型，而非最新的 AI4 硬體。此外，車主必須訂閱「高級車載娛樂服務」(Premium Connectivity)，目前在中國市場的訂閱費用為每月 9.99 元人民幣。
更新後的智慧語音助手不僅能提供即時資訊，還具備自然流暢的對話能力。特斯拉官方在社群媒體上指出，該助手具備唱歌、說故事及辯論等多元互動模式，並提供「萬事通」、「音樂愛好者」等多種個性化角色供選擇。
然而，現階段「豆包」助手僅限於資訊交互權限，相關助手目前尚無法直接控制車窗、空調等車輛硬體功能。當地評論人士認為，這體現了車企對行車安全的底線，車輛控制涉及核心操控安全，需經過更嚴苛的測試驗證，因此特斯拉採取了「引入本土模型補足互動短板，同時保留核心控制權」的折衷方案。
《CnEVPost》報導分析，中國本土電動車廠早已將 AI 語音助手視為標準配備，相比之下，特斯拉的座艙互動能力長期以來被視為弱點；此次合作是特斯拉推動座艙體驗在地化的實質性舉措。
對於字節跳動而言，這次合作意味著其大模型業務正式闖入「智慧座艙」這一黃金賽道。文章作者觀察到，字節跳動內部正透過整合「飛書」與「豆包」團隊，試圖打通 C 端消費場景與 B 端辦公應用，加速 AI 的商用落地。
除「豆包」外，特斯拉也曾披露與 DeepSeek 的合作，由後者負責 AI 閒聊功能。同時，報導指出阿里巴巴的「通義千問」(Qwen) 大型語言模型已進入深度測試階段，未來可能實現包括車輛控制與導航在內的更深層功能。
而在北美市場，特斯拉則持續使用由 Elon Musk 旗下 xAI 開發的 Grok 模型。這顯示特斯拉在全球不同市場採取了差異化的 AI 在地化策略，以應對各國語言與用戶習慣的挑戰。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) China announced on July 31 a vehicle‑software update (version 2026.14.13) covering Model 3, Model Y, Model S and Model X, marking the company’s formal adoption of ByteDance’s "Doubao" large language model (LLM). The move is seen as a key step for Tesla to strengthen its localized experience in the Chinese market and boost cabin competitiveness.

The AI feature is aimed at vehicles equipped with HW 3.0 or earlier hardware, not the newest AI4 hardware. Owners must subscribe to the Premium Connectivity service, which in China currently costs RMB 9.99 per month.

The upgraded smart voice assistant can provide real‑time information and engage in natural, fluid conversation. Tesla’s official social‑media post highlighted that the assistant can sing, tell stories, debate and offers multiple personalized personas such as "Jack‑of‑all‑trades" and "Music Lover" for users to choose from.

At present the "Doubao" assistant is limited to information‑exchange permissions and cannot directly control windows, climate or other vehicle hardware. Local commentators say this reflects automakers’ safety bottom line—vehicle control involves core safety functions that require stricter testing—so Tesla opted for a compromise: introduce a domestic model to fill interaction gaps while retaining core control rights.

According to CnEVPost, Chinese EV makers have long treated AI voice assistants as standard equipment, whereas Tesla’s cabin interaction has historically been viewed as a weakness; this partnership represents a substantive step toward localizing Tesla’s cabin experience.

For ByteDance, the deal signals its large‑model business entering the lucrative "smart cabin" arena. The article notes that ByteDance is integrating its Feishu and Doubao teams to bridge consumer (C‑end) scenarios with enterprise (B‑end) applications, accelerating commercial AI deployment.

In addition to Doubao, Tesla has disclosed a collaboration with DeepSeek, which handles AI chit‑chat functions. The report also mentions that Alibaba’s Qwen large language model is in deep‑testing phase and may later support deeper functions such as vehicle control and navigation.

In the North American market, Tesla continues to use the Grok model developed by Elon Musk’s xAI, illustrating Tesla’s differentiated AI localization strategy across regions to address language and user‑habit challenges.

items.title: SK海力士狂飆30%卻不是好事？南韓股市更大風暴恐在後頭
items.title_en: SK Hynix Soars 30%—But Is It a Bad Sign? A Bigger Storm May Loom for South Korea's Stock Market
paras: 《巴隆周刊》(Barron's)報導，SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 周五 (31 日) 在南韓股市狂飆 30%，三星電子也大漲 27%，帶動南韓綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 暴漲 18%。在資金重新湧入人工智慧 (AI) 概念股之際，這波強勁反彈雖讓投資人暫時鬆一口氣，但劇烈波動也暴露南韓股市的長期隱憂。
SK 海力士股價收在 171.8 萬韓元 (約 1,197 美元)。SK 海力士與三星電子兩大記憶體晶片巨頭聯袂大漲，成為推升 KOSPI 的主要動力。KOSPI 今年截至周五收盤累計上漲 57%，成為全球表現最強勁的股市，但上漲過程並不平穩。倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG) 資料顯示，KOSPI 過去十年來四次最大單日跌幅中，有三次發生在最近五周。
南韓散戶近來大舉押注 SK 海力士及其他科技股，並愈來愈常使用槓桿型 ETF 等高風險工具。這類 ETF 透過選擇權、交換合約及其他衍生性金融商品，放大標的每日漲跌幅；一旦市場下跌，投資人需要更大的反彈幅度才能回本，每日調整部位也可能侵蝕長期報酬。
市場原先期待，AI 類股近期下挫，加上南韓監管及政治壓力升高，能夠促使投資人降低槓桿並穩定市場。然而，SK 海力士與三星電子周五出現驚人漲幅，顯示南韓投資人手中仍有大量資金。若散戶再次透過槓桿型 ETF 追回先前虧損，恐為後續市場埋下更劇烈波動的風險。
不過，這不代表投資人應避開 SK 海力士美國存託憑證 (ADR)。該公司 ADR 周五盤前上漲 5.9%，報 158.07 美元，每 10 單位 ADR 代表一股南韓普通股。由於美國投資人需求龐大，加上 ADR 與普通股之間轉換存在障礙，SK 海力士 ADR 相較南韓股票享有明顯溢價。《巴隆周刊》先前仍看好其前景，認為相較美光 (MU-US)，SK 海力士是參與記憶體晶片榮景的另一項選擇。
此外，由 AI 避險基金 Situational Awareness 負責人阿申布倫納 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 管理的大部分股票投資組合已出售，可能減輕 SK 海力士 ADR 面臨的賣壓，為後續上漲騰出空間。
paras_en: Barron's reported that SK Hynix (SKHY-US) surged 30% on Friday (the 31st) in the South Korean market, while Samsung Electronics jumped 27%, driving the KOSPI index up an astonishing 18%. As capital rushes back into artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept stocks, this strong rebound gives investors a brief sigh of relief, but the extreme volatility also exposes long‑term concerns for South Korea’s equity market.

SK Hynix closed at 1.718 million won per share (about $1,197). The two memory‑chip giants, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, together powered the KOSPI’s rise. The index has risen 57% year‑to‑date as of Friday’s close, making it the best‑performing market globally, but the climb has been anything but smooth. Data from the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) show that three of the four biggest single‑day drops on the KOSPI in the past ten years have occurred in the last five weeks.

South Korean retail investors have recently placed large bets on SK Hynix and other tech stocks, increasingly using leveraged ETFs and other high‑risk tools. These ETFs amplify daily price moves through options, swaps and other derivatives; when the market falls, investors need an even larger rebound to break even, and daily position adjustments can erode long‑term returns.

The market had originally expected that a recent pullback in AI‑related stocks, combined with heightened regulatory and political pressure in South Korea, would force investors to cut leverage and stabilize the market. However, the startling gains by SK Hynix and Samsung on Friday show that a substantial amount of capital remains in the hands of South Korean investors. If retail traders again use leveraged ETFs to chase prior losses, they could sow the seeds for even more severe market swings.

That said, investors should not automatically avoid SK Hynix’s American Depositary Receipts (ADRs). The ADR rose 5.9% in pre‑market trading on Friday, reaching $158.07, with each 10‑ADR unit representing one ordinary share of the Korean stock. Because U.S. demand is strong and conversion between ADRs and the underlying Korean shares is not frictionless, SK Hynix ADRs trade at a noticeable premium to the domestic stock. Barron's has previously remained bullish on the company, viewing it as an alternative to Micron (MU-US) for participating in the memory‑chip boom.

In addition, most of the equity portfolio managed by AI‑hedge fund Situational Awareness’s head Leopold Aschenbrenner has been sold, which could ease selling pressure on SK Hynix ADRs and leave room for further upside.

items.title: 364萬人快刷存摺！首批退稅總金額610億元今入帳
items.title_en: 3.64 Million People Quickly Check Their Passbooks! First Batch of Tax Refunds Totalling NT$61 Billion Credited Today
paras: 財政部所屬各地區國稅局於今 (31) 日同步辦理 114 年度綜合所得稅結算申報第 1 批退稅作業，全國退稅件數達 364 萬餘件，退稅總金額高達 610 億餘元，相較於 113 年度的退稅表現，件數增加 2 萬餘件，退稅金額更顯著增加 25 億餘元，創下歷史新高紀錄，提醒符合資格的民眾盡快刷本子確認款項是否順利入帳。
財政部臺北國稅局進一步說明，本次第 1 批綜合所得稅退稅案件的適用範圍相當廣泛，主要涵蓋三大類民眾。首先是全面採用網路申報進行結算申報的退稅案件；其次是符合綜合所得稅稅額試算服務，並且透過線上或電話語音進行確認的退稅案件；最後則是符合稅額試算資格，並在 5 月 11 日以前透過書面方式向戶籍所在地國稅局完成確認的退稅案件，以上皆納入本次首批撥款的名單之中。
在領取退稅款的方式上，國稅局指出，納稅義務人在申報時如果選擇直撥退稅是最為安全且快速的管道，退稅款會在 7 月 31 日當天直接撥入民眾指定的存款帳戶中。不過，在此批退稅案件中，仍有大約 1.48% 的民眾沒有選擇直撥轉帳退稅。針對這部分納稅人，國稅局已於同日開立紙本退稅憑單，並正陸續透過掛號郵寄方式發送，請收到憑單的民眾務必在退稅憑單兌領有效期限 9 月 30 日之前儘速前往兌領。
針對持有紙本退稅憑單的兌領細節，國稅局說明，如果憑單金額未達 5000 元，民眾可以直接攜帶國民身分證、印章以及退稅憑單，前往憑單上所指定的臺灣銀行營業單位兌領現金。
如果憑單金額在 5000 元以上但未滿 20000 元者，則必須利用金融機構或是郵局的存款帳戶提出交換來領取退稅款。
至於憑單金額達 20000 元以上者，依法規定禁止背書轉讓，僅能將該張憑單存入受退稅人在金融機構或郵局所開立的存款帳戶中。
為了讓民眾未來能更有效率地領取退稅款，國稅局特別呼籲，建議大家在辦理綜合所得稅結算申報時，多加利用直撥退稅功能，直接提供個人的存款帳戶供稽徵機關辦理轉帳作業。如此一來，不僅退稅款項可以更早入帳，更能完全不必擔心紙本退稅憑單發生遺失或是遭人冒領的風險，同時也能省去親自往返金融機構排隊提兌的時間，可說是好處非常多的便利選擇。
最後，國稅局也特別提出防詐騙提醒，強調國稅局絕對不會透過電話指示民眾操作 ATM 來辦理轉帳退稅。民眾如果對退稅程序有任何疑問，可以直接撥打免付費服務電話 0800-000321，或是向戶籍所在地所屬的國稅局分局及稽徵所進行洽詢。
paras_en: On the 31st of this month, the regional National Tax Bureaus under the Ministry of Finance simultaneously processed the first batch of 2025 comprehensive income tax settlement refunds. A total of over 3.64 million refund cases were handled nationwide, with the total refund amount exceeding NT$61 billion. Compared with the 2024 refund performance, the number of cases increased by more than 20,000 and the refund amount rose by over NT$2.5 billion, setting a new historical record. Eligible taxpayers are reminded to check their accounts promptly to confirm that the funds have been deposited.

The Taipei National Tax Bureau of the Ministry of Finance explained that the scope of this first batch of comprehensive income tax refunds is very broad, covering three main groups of taxpayers. First are those who filed their settlement entirely online. Second are taxpayers who used the tax‑amount simulation service and confirmed their refunds online or by phone. Third are taxpayers who qualified for the simulation and, before May 11, submitted written confirmation to the tax bureau in their place of household registration. All of these groups are included in the first‑batch disbursement list.

Regarding how to receive the refunds, the tax bureau noted that taxpayers who chose direct‑deposit refunds during filing used the safest and fastest channel, with the money being transferred directly into the designated bank account on July 31. However, about 1.48 % of taxpayers in this batch did not select direct‑deposit. For these individuals, the bureau issued paper refund vouchers on the same day and is mailing them by registered mail. Recipients should redeem the vouchers before the September 30 deadline.

For details on redeeming paper vouchers, the bureau explained that if the voucher amount is less than NT$5,000, taxpayers can go to the Taiwan Bank branch indicated on the voucher and receive cash by presenting their national ID, seal, and the voucher.
If the voucher amount is between NT$5,000 and NT$20,000, the taxpayer must use a bank or post office deposit account to exchange the voucher for the refund.
For voucher amounts of NT$20,000 or more, the law prohibits endorsement or transfer; the voucher can only be deposited into a bank or post office account opened in the name of the refund recipient.

To help taxpayers receive refunds more efficiently in the future, the tax bureau strongly encourages the use of the direct‑deposit option when filing the comprehensive income tax settlement, providing a personal bank account for the tax authority to transfer the funds. This not only speeds up the receipt of refunds but also eliminates the risk of losing or having paper vouchers stolen, and saves the time spent traveling to and queuing at financial institutions—a highly convenient choice.

Finally, the tax bureau issued an anti‑fraud reminder, emphasizing that it will never ask taxpayers to operate an ATM over the phone to process a refund transfer. If anyone has questions about the refund process, they can call the toll‑free number 0800‑000321 or contact the local tax bureau branch or assessment office in their place of household registration.

items.title: 下周一再新增8檔股票抓去關 ABF股王南電關至8/18處置最久
items.title_en: Eight More Stocks Added for Delisting Next Monday; ABF Leader Nandian Delisted Until August 18, the Longest Duration
paras: 台股今 (31) 日上演奇蹟日超級大反彈，終場創史上最大漲點 3,186 點，證交所與櫃買中心也新增 8 檔處置股，共 4 檔上市、4 檔上櫃股，包括南電 (3046-TW)、禾伸堂 (3026-TW)、泰宗 (4169-TW)、愛普 *(6531-TW)、光頡 (3624-TW)、合晶 (6182-TW)、竹陞科技 (6739-TW)、創新服務 (7828-TW)。南電自下周一 (8 月 3 日) 處置至 8 月 18 日最久，其餘 7 檔則關到 8 月 14 日為止。
新增 8 檔處置股中，涵蓋 ABF、被動元件、矽晶圓、半導體設備廠及生技類股。其中禾伸堂是延長處置至 8 月 14 日。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks staged a miraculous super rebound today (the 31st), ending with a historic high gain of 3,186 points. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market also added eight delisted stocks, four listed and four over‑the‑counter, including Nandian (3046‑TW), He Shen Tang (3026‑TW), Tai Zong (4169‑TW), iPE *(6531‑TW), Guang Jie (3624‑TW), He Jing (6182‑TW), Zhu Sheng Technology (6739‑TW) and Chuang Xin Service (7828‑TW). Among the eight newly delisted stocks are companies in ABF, passive components, silicon wafers, semiconductor equipment and biotech sectors. He Shen Tang’s delisting period has been extended to August 14.

The ABF carrier stock leader Nandian is being delisted because over the most recent six trading days its cumulative closing‑price decline reached 26.89% and the price difference between the closing price on the sixth day and that two days later was NT$190.00. On July 30, the intraday offset‑trade volume for the most recent six trading days accounted for 70.69% of the total volume for those six days, and the offset‑trade volume on July 30 alone made up 79.4% of that day’s total volume.

He Shen Tang’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 41.27% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$190 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

Tai Zong’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 48.42% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$82.5 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

iPE’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 28.15% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$191 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

Guang Jie’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 37.6% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days. Uni-President Securities’ entrusted sell volume for the security that day accounted for 32.22% of the day’s total volume, while Morgan Stanley Securities’ entrusted buy volume accounted for 31.9% of the day’s total volume.
He Jing’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 32.9% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.
Zhu Sheng Technology’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 34.8% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.
Chuang Xin Service’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 31.99% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days, including today.

items.title: 東典光電自結6月獲利由虧轉盈 濾光片切入5G與資料中心
items.title_en: Dongdian Optoelectronics Turns June Profit Around, Expands Filter Business into 5G and Data Centers
paras: 光通訊濾光片廠東典光電 (6588-TW) 近期因股價達主管機關要求公告交易資訊標準，東典今 (31) 日公告今年 6 月份自結獲利，稅後純益為 800 萬元、每股純益為 0.22 元，皆較去 (2025) 年同期由虧轉盈。
東典光電今年上半年營收為 1.83 億元、年增達 132.45%，公司去 (2025) 年經營層重組，引進了在 AI、半導體、光電以及財務管理等各方面的專業人才，進行多產業布局，透過產品組合調整、成本控管與營運效率改善，營運將持續轉佳。
東典目前主力產品為應用於光通訊主動與被動元件、雲端資料中心的薄膜濾光片，上半年月營收明顯放量，年成長率維持高雙位數，顯示 5G 建設與資料中心需求正逐步反映在訂單動能。東典今日股價開高走高，尾盤在資金湧進下攻上漲停價 89.1 元，外資也由賣轉買。
法人指出，東典近年持續聚焦高速光通訊與 AI 資料中心應用，並深化高階光學鍍膜技術布局，目前相關產品已應用於 400G、800G 高速光模組、PON 及資料中心高速傳輸架構等領域，公司也持續投入 800G/1.6T 相關 Filter 產品，與高階光學元件開發，強化高速光通訊市場布局與產品競爭力。
paras_en: Optoelectronic filter maker Dongdian Optoelectronics (6588‑TW) recently met the regulatory threshold for mandatory disclosure of trading information. On the 31st, the company announced its June‑month earnings, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$8 million and earnings per share of NT$0.22, both turning from a loss in the same period of 2025 to a profit.

For the first half of this year, Dongdian’s revenue reached NT$183 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 132.45%. The company underwent a management reshuffle in 2025, bringing in professionals with expertise in AI, semiconductors, optoelectronics and financial management to pursue a multi‑industry strategy. Through product‑mix adjustments, cost control and operational efficiency improvements, its performance is expected to keep improving.

Dongdian’s core products are thin‑film optical filters used in active and passive components for optical communications and cloud data centers. Monthly revenue in the first half surged, maintaining a high double‑digit annual growth rate, indicating that 5G rollout and data‑center demand are gradually translating into order momentum. The stock opened higher and rose throughout the day, closing at the daily limit price of NT$89.1 as capital poured in, with foreign investors switching from selling to buying.

Analysts note that Dongdian has continued to focus on high‑speed optical communications and AI data‑center applications, deepening its advanced optical coating technology portfolio. Its related products are already deployed in 400G and 800G high‑speed optical modules, PON systems and high‑speed data‑center transmission architectures. The company is also investing in 800G/1.6T filter products and advanced optical component development to strengthen its market position and product competitiveness in the high‑speed optical communications sector.

items.title: 中油8月家戶民生天然氣凍漲 工業漲5%、電業漲近1成
items.title_en: CPC Corp. Freezes Household and Residential Natural Gas Prices in August, Raises Industrial Prices by 5% and Power Sector by Nearly 10%
paras: 台灣中油今 (31) 日宣布，受中東地緣政治衝突升溫影響，國際油氣價格持續走揚，致使進口氣源成本大幅增加。為配合政府穩定國內物價政策，8 月家戶與民生用戶天然氣價格全面凍漲，由台灣中油全力吸收，照顧全台家庭、商業及服務業等民生類用戶，有效減輕民生負擔。不過，針對工業及電業大戶則進行合理調整，其中工業用戶平均調漲 5%，電業用戶則調漲 9.91%，逼近一成幅度，盼在兼顧產業承受能力與反映成本間取得平衡。
台灣中油表示，自 110 年至 115 年 6 月止，針對工業用戶已累計吸收金額逾 1400 億元。考量國內物價穩定及整體經濟情勢，本次工業用戶天然氣價格平均調漲 5%，相較於國際液化天然氣價格波動，調幅相當緩和，調整後價格仍遠低於實際成本，未足額反映部分持續由中油吸收。至於電業用戶方面，為合理反映上漲的氣源成本，8 月天然氣價格則調漲 9.91%，接近一成水準。
中油強調，國際能源價格受地緣政治干擾劇烈，但為顧及廣大市井小民與商業服務業的經營壓力，民生天然氣價格堅持不調漲。自 110 年以來，中油為穩定國內物價已吞下龐大吸收金額，未來將持續密切掌握國際油氣市場動態，並配合政府穩定物價政策滾動檢討，確保整體經濟穩健運行。有關各用戶別天然氣產品價格，民眾可至台灣中油全球資訊網公告之天然氣牌價表查詢詳情，以掌握最新資訊。
paras_en: Taiwan CPC Corp. announced today (31st) that rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have pushed international oil and gas prices higher, sharply increasing the cost of imported gas. To support the government’s price‑stability policy, CPC will fully absorb the cost increase for all household and residential natural‑gas users in August, protecting families, commercial and service‑sector customers across Taiwan and easing the burden on everyday life. However, for large industrial and power‑sector customers, a reasonable adjustment will be made: industrial users will see an average price increase of 5%, while power‑sector users will face a 9.91% rise, close to a ten‑percent jump, aiming to balance industry affordability with cost recovery.

CPC noted that from 2021 to June 2026, it has already absorbed more than NT$140 billion in costs for industrial users. Considering domestic price stability and overall economic conditions, the 5% average increase for industrial natural‑gas prices is modest relative to the volatility of international LNG prices; the adjusted price remains far below actual cost, with CPC still covering a portion of the gap. For power‑sector users, the 9.91% increase in August reflects the higher gas‑source costs more accurately, approaching a ten‑percent level.

CPC emphasized that while international energy prices are highly volatile due to geopolitical disruptions, the company will keep residential natural‑gas prices unchanged to relieve pressure on ordinary citizens and the commercial service sector. Since 2021, CPC has absorbed a huge amount of cost to stabilize domestic prices and will continue to closely monitor global oil‑gas markets, working with the government’s price‑stability policy for ongoing review to ensure a sound overall economy. Details of natural‑gas product prices for each user category are available on CPC’s global website under the natural‑gas price list, where the public can check the latest information.

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market surged today (31st) by 3,186.45 points, marking the biggest point gain in history. Foreign investors net bought NT$67.554 billion, investment trusts continued buying NT$33.382 billion, while proprietary traders still sold NT$16.26 billion, resulting in a combined net purchase of NT$84.676 billion by the three major institutional investors. However, foreign investors increased their futures short positions by 4,292 contracts, bringing the total to 82,500 contracts.

On the last trading day of July, the Taiwan market jumped sharply and foreign investors made a substantial net purchase, lifting the gain to 3,186.45 points and narrowing the monthly net loss to 3,006.16 points. For the month, foreign investors’ net selling turned into a net purchase of NT$73.8926 billion.

Notably, TSMC was net bought today by foreign investors for 13,700 shares and by investment trusts for 7,047 shares, totaling more than 20,000 shares. Foreign investors also net bought Foxconn for 49,800 shares and investment trusts for 3,505 shares; Kai‑Fund and Yong‑Feng Financial were also simultaneously net bought by both foreign investors and investment trusts, while Winbond was net sold by both domestic and foreign investors.

Foreign investors aggressively bought ETFs, led by Uni-President Active Taiwan 50 (00981A) with 374,400 shares, followed by Active Fuhua Future 50 (00991A) with 340,900 shares, Active Uni‑President Upgrade 50 (00403A) with 169,100 shares, and Active Quanta Technology Innovation (00992A) with 106,700 shares. They also bought Yuan‑Ta Taiwan 50 (0050) for 84,100 shares, Yuan‑Ta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L) for 51,600 shares, and took net long positions in the two airline giants: EVA Air 40,000 shares and China Airlines 37,700 shares.

On the selling side, mature‑process wafer foundries were heavily withdrawn, including UMC (2303) with 21,600 shares, GlobalWafers with 6,433 shares, and Powerchip with 3,878 shares. Panel makers also saw net sales, such as Innolux with 12,500 shares and AU Optronics with 8,933 shares. Other electronics stocks sold included Sino‑Metal (1,550 shares), Delta Electronics (6,105 shares), Strongwell (7,867 shares), Winbond (6,622 shares), as well as Qibond, Quanta Computer, and Advantech each over 4,000 shares.

In addition, foreign investors sharply cut positions in the petrochemical sector, selling major components of Formosa Plastics Group: Formosa Plastics (14,500 shares), Formosa Chemical (9,623 shares), Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (8,349 shares), China Synthetic Fiber (11,300 shares), Hengtong (6,655 shares) and New Fiber (3,947 shares).

items.title: 致茂法說透漏這個產業即將進入強勁循環！
items.title_en: Zhi Mao Reveals That This Industry Is About to Enter a Strong Cycle!
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 市場在經歷大跌之後，現在最想知道的是接下來哪個產業會最快迎來成長動能。
致茂的法說就透漏了這樣的訊息。
致茂的設備涵蓋AI伺服器電源、GPU與ASIC測試、先進封裝、光通訊、BBU及儲能系統等領域。
從公司這次法說會揭露的設備進度，可以進一步整理出AI供應鏈接下來的出貨節奏。
致茂(2360-TW)2026年第二季合併營收135.29億元，季增14%、年增110%，連續兩季創下歷史新高；上半年合併營收253.89億元，年增91%，每股盈餘21.27元。
從產品組合來看，上半年量測及自動化檢測設備營收115.59億元，年增136%；半導體與光通訊測試解決方案營收77.96億元，年增62%。
設備通常會在客戶正式量產以前進入產線。
客戶收到設備後，還要經過安裝、驗收、製程調整及試產，後續產品才會逐步增加出貨。
因此，搭配設備的出貨時程，就能往後推估客戶可能在什麼時間進入量產，以及相關供應鏈的營運動能何時開始轉強。
量測及自動化檢測設備成長最快，主要受到AI伺服器電源、HVDC及儲能系統測試需求帶動。
公司表示，AI相關需求已占電力電子測試營收約60%，大多與AI資料中心的電源供應器測試有關。
公布的財務數字可以告訴我們哪些客戶近期營運動能有望轉強；接下來再搭配新品的出貨進度，就能推估客戶何時開始增加出貨。

AI電源設備需求已經出現，客戶相關產品正進入出貨期
目前進度走得最前面的是AI伺服器電源。
此外，致茂下半年將推出3.6MW電網模擬器、2.7MW直流電子負載及1.8MW雙向直流電源，測試範圍已經從單一電源供應器，擴大到伺服器機櫃與伺服器集群。
搭配量測設備部門上半年營收年增136%，可以看出AI電源供應鏈已進入實際擴產階段。
接下來AI伺服器電源供應器、HVDC電源轉換設備以及整櫃電力系統供應商，如台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)等電源供應器大廠營運動能會比較快看到反映。

半導體後段測試客戶準備在2026年底至2027年產能爬坡
致茂的高功率老化測試設備已經接單，確定在2026年下半年出貨；公司也表示，多個GPU、CPU及交換器晶片客戶將在下半年推出新品或進行量產爬坡。
依照設備下半年進場的時間推估，相關晶片、封測及測試介面供應鏈的營運動能，較可能從2026年底至2027年增強。

BBU、儲能、光通訊測試設備下半年交付，相關供應鏈正在建置下一代新品產能
致茂的光引擎、CPO模組與雷射老化測試設備預計在2026年下半年出貨。
同一時間，最高可擴充至4MW的電池測試系統也將陸續交付，需求涵蓋資料中心BBU及ESS儲能。
BBU、電池模組、電池芯、EDLC、儲能系統整合商以及CPO相關供應鏈的營運動能較可能在2026年底至2027年逐步反映。

面板級封裝仍在客戶驗證
面板級先進封裝量測設備已安裝於客戶端，正在進行調整試用。
顯示面板級封裝距離大規模量產仍有變動空間。

致茂設備交付進度透露的客戶營運順序
從致茂法說會可以整理出AI供應鏈的目前的三個營運狀態：
AI電源相關供應鏈已經進入擴產與出貨，成長動能正在發生。
半導體後段測試、光通訊、BBU及儲能客戶正在逐步新增、建置產能，營運較可能在2026年底至2027年轉強。
面板級封裝客戶仍在進行驗證，相關產品量產仍有待觀察。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After a market plunge, investors now want to know which sector will be the first to regain growth momentum.
Zhi Mao’s earnings briefing disclosed such information.
Zhi Mao’s equipment covers AI server power supplies, GPU and ASIC testing, advanced packaging, optical communications, BBU and energy storage systems, among others.
From the equipment progress revealed at the briefing, the upcoming shipment rhythm of the AI supply chain can be further outlined.

Zhi Mao (2360‑TW) posted Q2 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$13.529 billion, up 14% sequentially and 110% year‑over‑year, marking a second consecutive record high; H1 consolidated revenue reached NT$25.389 billion, up 91% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$21.27.

By product mix, H1 revenue from measurement and automated testing equipment was NT$11.559 billion, up 136% YoY; semiconductor and optical‑communication test solutions generated NT$7.796 billion, up 62% YoY.
Equipment typically enters the production line before customers begin mass production.
After receiving equipment, customers must install, accept, adjust processes and run pilot production before product shipments gradually increase.
Thus, the equipment delivery schedule allows us to infer when customers may start volume production and when related supply‑chain operating momentum will pick up.
Measurement and automated testing equipment is growing fastest, driven mainly by demand for AI server power supplies, HVDC and energy‑storage system testing.
The company says AI‑related demand now accounts for about 60% of its power‑electronics testing revenue, largely tied to power‑supply testing for AI data centers.
The disclosed financial figures indicate which customers’ operating momentum may strengthen soon; combined with new‑product shipment progress, we can estimate when customers will increase shipments.
Demand for AI power‑supply equipment has already emerged, and related customer products are entering the shipment phase.
The most advanced progress is in AI server power supplies.

In addition, Zhi Mao will launch a 3.6 MW grid simulator, a 2.7 MW DC electronic load and a 1.8 MW bidirectional DC power supply in the second half of the year, expanding test coverage from single power supplies to server racks and clusters.
With measurement‑equipment revenue up 136% YoY in H1, the AI power‑supply chain has entered a real expansion stage.

Going forward, AI server power‑supply manufacturers, HVDC converters and full‑rack power system suppliers such as Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and Lite-On (2301‑TW) are expected to see faster operational improvements.
Semiconductor back‑end test customers are preparing for capacity ramp‑up from late 2026 to 2027.

Zhi Mao’s high‑power aging test equipment has already received orders for delivery in H2 2026; the company also says several GPU, CPU and switch‑chip customers will launch new products or ramp up volume production in the second half.
Based on the timing of equipment arrivals in H2, the operating momentum of related chip, packaging and test‑interface supply chains is likely to strengthen from the end of 2026 into 2027.
BBU, energy‑storage and optical‑communication test equipment will be delivered in H2, with the next‑generation product capacity being built out.
Zhi Mao’s optical engine, CPO modules and laser aging test equipment are slated for H2 2026 shipment.
At the same time, battery test systems scalable up to 4 MW will be delivered gradually, serving data‑center BBU and ESS storage needs.
The operating momentum of BBU, battery modules, cells, EDLCs, storage‑system integrators and CPO‑related supply chains is expected to materialize progressively from late 2026 to 2027.
Panel‑level advanced packaging is still under customer verification.
Panel‑level advanced‑packaging measurement equipment has been installed at the customer site and is undergoing adjustment trials.
Large‑scale volume production of display‑panel packaging still has uncertainty.
Customer operating sequence revealed by Zhi Mao’s equipment delivery schedule
From the briefing, three current operating states of the AI supply chain can be summarized:
AI power‑supply related supply chain has entered expansion and shipment, with growth momentum underway.
Semiconductor back‑end test, optical‑communication, BBU and energy‑storage customers are gradually adding and building capacity, with operations likely to strengthen by the end of 2026 into 2027.
Panel‑level packaging customers remain in verification, and mass production of related products is still to be observed.

items.title: 智冠參展ChinaJoy推AI賦能一站式解方 開拓數位娛樂新商機
items.title_en: iDreamSky Showcases AI-Powered One‑Stop Solution at ChinaJoy, Opening New Digital Entertainment Opportunities
paras: 智冠 (5478-TW) 今 (31) 日於「2026 ChinaJoy 中國國際數碼互動娛樂展覽會」上海 BTOB 展區亮相，以「AI 賦能一站式解方」為主題，透過 AI 工具優化全方位服務，由 MyCard 為核心入口，整合支付、流量、內容、營運與技術支援等資源，開拓數位娛樂新商機。
智冠表示，延續多年深耕數位娛樂產業的堅實基礎，今年進一步將 AI 應用在既有服務流程，讓一站式服務從「資源整合」推進至「流程優化」，將支付、流量、內容與營運資源串接成可實際執行的出海流程，以達成降低試錯、時間成本，增加效能與反應速度。
而遊戲出海落地的第一步，是讓玩家能進入應用場景、並順利完成消費，智冠表示，MyCard 作為集團旗下數位娛樂領導品牌，持續扮演一站式服務的重要入口，範疇橫跨台港澳、東南亞、南美洲等高成長市場，提供信用卡、手機帳單、電子錢包、銀行轉帳、超商付款、BNPL 等上百種支付方式，滿足玩家支付需求。
智冠集團結合 760 萬會員基礎、串接數千款遊戲與數位內容支付、通路宣傳與線下活動資源，透過全台便利商店、超市、知名餐飲等高人流實體場域，結合街頭玩家見面會與主題地推活動，協助品牌深入玩家日常場景，提升市場觸及與互動效益，協助海外廠商快速接軌玩家消費場景。
遊戲成功進入在地市場後，後續需要穩定營運、經營玩家社群與持續互動。智冠集團整合數位行銷、AI 素材應用、內容製作、客服社群、營運代操與雲端資安等資源，協助合作夥伴依據產品上市、改版活動與營運需求，建立從市場溝通、玩家經營到技術支援的完整服務鏈，讓產品持續累積價值。
面對全球遊戲市場競爭加速，智冠強調，將以 AI 應用與一站式解方整合，憑藉完整的服務鏈優勢快速回應市場需求，深化與全球遊戲開發商、發行商及數位內容夥伴的合作，協助產品從市場導入、玩家觸及、長線營運建立完整佈局，共同拓展數位娛樂產業新商機。
paras_en: iDreamSky (5478‑TW) appeared today (31st) at the Shanghai B2B zone of the 2026 ChinaJoy International Digital Interactive Entertainment Exhibition, presenting a theme of “AI‑Empowered One‑Stop Solution.” Using AI tools to optimise a full‑range of services, the company positions MyCard as the core entry point and integrates payment, traffic, content, operations and technical support resources to explore new digital‑entertainment business opportunities.

iDreamSky said that building on its many years of a solid foundation in the digital‑entertainment industry, it is this year further applying AI to its existing service processes, moving the one‑stop service from “resource integration” to “process optimisation.” By linking payment, traffic, content and operational resources into a practical overseas‑expansion workflow, the company aims to reduce trial‑and‑error and time costs while increasing efficiency and response speed.

The first step for game expansion overseas is to let players enter the application scenario and complete purchases smoothly. iDreamSky noted that MyCard, the group’s leading digital‑entertainment brand, continues to serve as an important one‑stop entry point, covering high‑growth markets such as Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, Southeast Asia and South America. It offers hundreds of payment methods—including credit cards, mobile‑bill payments, e‑wallets, bank transfers, convenience‑store payments and BNPL—to meet players’ payment needs.

Leveraging a base of 7.6 million members, connections to thousands of games and digital‑content payments, and channel promotion and offline‑event resources, iDreamSky uses high‑traffic physical venues such as convenience stores, supermarkets and well‑known restaurants across Taiwan. Combined with street‑level player meet‑ups and themed ground‑promotion activities, the company helps brands penetrate players’ daily scenes, boost market reach and interaction effectiveness, and assists overseas developers in quickly linking to player‑spending contexts.

After a game successfully enters a local market, ongoing stable operations, community management and continuous interaction are required. iDreamSky integrates digital marketing, AI‑generated assets, content creation, community customer service, operational outsourcing and cloud security resources to help partners build a complete service chain—from market communication and player management to technical support—based on product launches, version updates and operational needs, ensuring the product continuously accumulates value.

Facing accelerating competition in the global game market, iDreamSky emphasised that it will combine AI applications with its one‑stop solution, leveraging its comprehensive service‑chain advantage to respond quickly to market demand. The company aims to deepen cooperation with global game developers, publishers and digital‑content partners, assisting products in market entry, player outreach and long‑term operation to establish a complete layout and jointly expand new opportunities in the digital‑entertainment industry.

items.title: 364萬人快刷存摺！首批退稅總金額610億元今入帳
items.title_en: 3.64 Million People Quickly Check Their Passbooks! First Batch of Tax Refunds Totalling NT$61 Billion Credited Today
paras: 財政部所屬各地區國稅局於今 (31) 日同步辦理 114 年度綜合所得稅結算申報第 1 批退稅作業，全國退稅件數達 364 萬餘件，退稅總金額高達 610 億餘元，相較於 113 年度的退稅表現，件數增加 2 萬餘件，退稅金額更顯著增加 25 億餘元，創下歷史新高紀錄，提醒符合資格的民眾盡快刷本子確認款項是否順利入帳。
財政部臺北國稅局進一步說明，本次第 1 批綜合所得稅退稅案件的適用範圍相當廣泛，主要涵蓋三大類民眾。首先是全面採用網路申報進行結算申報的退稅案件；其次是符合綜合所得稅稅額試算服務，並且透過線上或電話語音進行確認的退稅案件；最後則是符合稅額試算資格，並在 5 月 11 日以前透過書面方式向戶籍所在地國稅局完成確認的退稅案件，以上皆納入本次首批撥款的名單之中。
在領取退稅款的方式上，國稅局指出，納稅義務人在申報時如果選擇直撥退稅是最為安全且快速的管道，退稅款會在 7 月 31 日當天直接撥入民眾指定的存款帳戶中。不過，在此批退稅案件中，仍有大約 1.48% 的民眾沒有選擇直撥轉帳退稅。針對這部分納稅人，國稅局已於同日開立紙本退稅憑單，並正陸續透過掛號郵寄方式發送，請收到憑單的民眾務必在退稅憑單兌領有效期限 9 月 30 日之前儘速前往兌領。
針對持有紙本退稅憑單的兌領細節，國稅局說明，如果憑單金額未達 5000 元，民眾可以直接攜帶國民身分證、印章以及退稅憑單，前往憑單上所指定的臺灣銀行營業單位兌領現金。
如果憑單金額在 5000 元以上但未滿 20000 元者，則必須利用金融機構或是郵局的存款帳戶提出交換來領取退稅款。
至於憑單金額達 20000 元以上者，依法規定禁止背書轉讓，僅能將該張憑單存入受退稅人在金融機構或郵局所開立的存款帳戶中。
為了讓民眾未來能更有效率地領取退稅款，國稅局特別呼籲，建議大家在辦理綜合所得稅結算申報時，多加利用直撥退稅功能，直接提供個人的存款帳戶供稽徵機關辦理轉帳作業。如此一來，不僅退稅款項可以更早入帳，更能完全不必擔心紙本退稅憑單發生遺失或是遭人冒領的風險，同時也能省去親自往返金融機構排隊提兌的時間，可說是好處非常多的便利選擇。
最後，國稅局也特別提出防詐騙提醒，強調國稅局絕對不會透過電話指示民眾操作 ATM 來辦理轉帳退稅。民眾如果對退稅程序有任何疑問，可以直接撥打免付費服務電話 0800-000321，或是向戶籍所在地所屬的國稅局分局及稽徵所進行洽詢。
paras_en: On the 31st of this month, the regional National Tax Bureaus under the Ministry of Finance simultaneously processed the first batch of 2025 comprehensive income tax settlement refunds. A total of over 3.64 million refund cases were handled nationwide, with the total refund amount exceeding NT$61 billion. Compared with the 2024 refund performance, the number of cases increased by more than 20,000 and the refund amount rose by over NT$2.5 billion, setting a new historical record. Eligible taxpayers are reminded to check their accounts promptly to confirm that the funds have been deposited.

The Taipei National Tax Bureau of the Ministry of Finance explained that the scope of this first batch of comprehensive income tax refunds is very broad, covering three main groups of taxpayers. First are those who filed their settlement entirely online. Second are taxpayers who used the tax‑amount simulation service and confirmed their refunds online or by phone. Third are taxpayers who qualified for the simulation and, before May 11, submitted written confirmation to the tax bureau in their place of household registration. All of these groups are included in the first‑batch disbursement list.

Regarding how to receive the refunds, the tax bureau noted that taxpayers who chose direct‑deposit refunds during filing used the safest and fastest channel, with the money being transferred directly into the designated bank account on July 31. However, about 1.48 % of taxpayers in this batch did not select direct‑deposit. For these individuals, the bureau issued paper refund vouchers on the same day and is mailing them by registered mail. Recipients should redeem the vouchers before the September 30 deadline.

For details on redeeming paper vouchers, the bureau explained that if the voucher amount is less than NT$5,000, taxpayers can go to the Taiwan Bank branch indicated on the voucher and receive cash by presenting their national ID, seal, and the voucher.
If the voucher amount is between NT$5,000 and NT$20,000, the taxpayer must use a bank or post office deposit account to exchange the voucher for the refund.
For voucher amounts of NT$20,000 or more, the law prohibits endorsement or transfer; the voucher can only be deposited into a bank or post office account opened in the name of the refund recipient.

To help taxpayers receive refunds more efficiently in the future, the tax bureau strongly encourages the use of the direct‑deposit option when filing the comprehensive income tax settlement, providing a personal bank account for the tax authority to transfer the funds. This not only speeds up the receipt of refunds but also eliminates the risk of losing or having paper vouchers stolen, and saves the time spent traveling to and queuing at financial institutions—a highly convenient choice.

Finally, the tax bureau issued an anti‑fraud reminder, emphasizing that it will never ask taxpayers to operate an ATM over the phone to process a refund transfer. If anyone has questions about the refund process, they can call the toll‑free number 0800‑000321 or contact the local tax bureau branch or assessment office in their place of household registration.

paras: 台股今 (31) 日上演奇蹟日超級大反彈，終場創史上最大漲點 3,186 點，證交所與櫃買中心也新增 8 檔處置股，共 4 檔上市、4 檔上櫃股，包括南電 (3046-TW)、禾伸堂 (3026-TW)、泰宗 (4169-TW)、愛普 *(6531-TW)、光頡 (3624-TW)、合晶 (6182-TW)、竹陞科技 (6739-TW)、創新服務 (7828-TW)。南電自下周一 (8 月 3 日) 處置至 8 月 18 日最久，其餘 7 檔則關到 8 月 14 日為止。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks staged a miraculous super rebound today (the 31st), ending with a historic high gain of 3,186 points. He Shen Tang’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 41.27% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$190 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

Guang Jie’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 37.6% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days. Uni-President Securities’ entrusted sell volume for the security that day accounted for 32.22% of the day’s total volume, while Morgan Stanley Securities’ entrusted buy volume accounted for 31.9% of the day’s total volume.
He Jing’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 32.9% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.
Zhu Sheng Technology’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 34.8% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.

items.title: 東典光電自結6月獲利由虧轉盈 濾光片切入5G與資料中心
items.title_en: Dongdian Optoelectronics Turns June Profit Around, Expands Filter Business into 5G and Data Centers
paras: 光通訊濾光片廠東典光電 (6588-TW) 近期因股價達主管機關要求公告交易資訊標準，東典今 (31) 日公告今年 6 月份自結獲利，稅後純益為 800 萬元、每股純益為 0.22 元，皆較去 (2025) 年同期由虧轉盈。
東典光電今年上半年營收為 1.83 億元、年增達 132.45%，公司去 (2025) 年經營層重組，引進了在 AI、半導體、光電以及財務管理等各方面的專業人才，進行多產業布局，透過產品組合調整、成本控管與營運效率改善，營運將持續轉佳。
東典目前主力產品為應用於光通訊主動與被動元件、雲端資料中心的薄膜濾光片，上半年月營收明顯放量，年成長率維持高雙位數，顯示 5G 建設與資料中心需求正逐步反映在訂單動能。東典今日股價開高走高，尾盤在資金湧進下攻上漲停價 89.1 元，外資也由賣轉買。
法人指出，東典近年持續聚焦高速光通訊與 AI 資料中心應用，並深化高階光學鍍膜技術布局，目前相關產品已應用於 400G、800G 高速光模組、PON 及資料中心高速傳輸架構等領域，公司也持續投入 800G/1.6T 相關 Filter 產品，與高階光學元件開發，強化高速光通訊市場布局與產品競爭力。
paras_en: Optoelectronic filter maker Dongdian Optoelectronics (6588‑TW) recently met the regulatory threshold for mandatory disclosure of trading information. On the 31st, the company announced its June‑month earnings, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$8 million and earnings per share of NT$0.22, both turning from a loss in the same period of 2025 to a profit.

For the first half of this year, Dongdian’s revenue reached NT$183 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 132.45%. The company underwent a management reshuffle in 2025, bringing in professionals with expertise in AI, semiconductors, optoelectronics and financial management to pursue a multi‑industry strategy. Through product‑mix adjustments, cost control and operational efficiency improvements, its performance is expected to keep improving.

Dongdian’s core products are thin‑film optical filters used in active and passive components for optical communications and cloud data centers. Monthly revenue in the first half surged, maintaining a high double‑digit annual growth rate, indicating that 5G rollout and data‑center demand are gradually translating into order momentum. The stock opened higher and rose throughout the day, closing at the daily limit price of NT$89.1 as capital poured in, with foreign investors switching from selling to buying.

Analysts note that Dongdian has continued to focus on high‑speed optical communications and AI data‑center applications, deepening its advanced optical coating technology portfolio. Its related products are already deployed in 400G and 800G high‑speed optical modules, PON systems and high‑speed data‑center transmission architectures. The company is also investing in 800G/1.6T filter products and advanced optical component development to strengthen its market position and product competitiveness in the high‑speed optical communications sector.

items.title: 中油8月家戶民生天然氣凍漲 工業漲5%、電業漲近1成
items.title_en: CPC Corp. Freezes Household and Residential Natural Gas Prices in August, Raises Industrial Prices by 5% and Power Sector by Nearly 10%
paras: 台灣中油今 (31) 日宣布，受中東地緣政治衝突升溫影響，國際油氣價格持續走揚，致使進口氣源成本大幅增加。為配合政府穩定國內物價政策，8 月家戶與民生用戶天然氣價格全面凍漲，由台灣中油全力吸收，照顧全台家庭、商業及服務業等民生類用戶，有效減輕民生負擔。不過，針對工業及電業大戶則進行合理調整，其中工業用戶平均調漲 5%，電業用戶則調漲 9.91%，逼近一成幅度，盼在兼顧產業承受能力與反映成本間取得平衡。
台灣中油表示，自 110 年至 115 年 6 月止，針對工業用戶已累計吸收金額逾 1400 億元。考量國內物價穩定及整體經濟情勢，本次工業用戶天然氣價格平均調漲 5%，相較於國際液化天然氣價格波動，調幅相當緩和，調整後價格仍遠低於實際成本，未足額反映部分持續由中油吸收。至於電業用戶方面，為合理反映上漲的氣源成本，8 月天然氣價格則調漲 9.91%，接近一成水準。
中油強調，國際能源價格受地緣政治干擾劇烈，但為顧及廣大市井小民與商業服務業的經營壓力，民生天然氣價格堅持不調漲。自 110 年以來，中油為穩定國內物價已吞下龐大吸收金額，未來將持續密切掌握國際油氣市場動態，並配合政府穩定物價政策滾動檢討，確保整體經濟穩健運行。有關各用戶別天然氣產品價格，民眾可至台灣中油全球資訊網公告之天然氣牌價表查詢詳情，以掌握最新資訊。
paras_en: Taiwan CPC Corp. announced today (31st) that rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have pushed international oil and gas prices higher, sharply increasing the cost of imported gas. To support the government’s price‑stability policy, CPC will fully absorb the cost increase for all household and residential natural‑gas users in August, protecting families, commercial and service‑sector customers across Taiwan and easing the burden on everyday life. However, for large industrial and power‑sector customers, a reasonable adjustment will be made: industrial users will see an average price increase of 5%, while power‑sector users will face a 9.91% rise, close to a ten‑percent jump, aiming to balance industry affordability with cost recovery.

CPC noted that from 2021 to June 2026, it has already absorbed more than NT$140 billion in costs for industrial users. Considering domestic price stability and overall economic conditions, the 5% average increase for industrial natural‑gas prices is modest relative to the volatility of international LNG prices; the adjusted price remains far below actual cost, with CPC still covering a portion of the gap. For power‑sector users, the 9.91% increase in August reflects the higher gas‑source costs more accurately, approaching a ten‑percent level.

CPC emphasized that while international energy prices are highly volatile due to geopolitical disruptions, the company will keep residential natural‑gas prices unchanged to relieve pressure on ordinary citizens and the commercial service sector. Since 2021, CPC has absorbed a huge amount of cost to stabilize domestic prices and will continue to closely monitor global oil‑gas markets, working with the government’s price‑stability policy for ongoing review to ensure a sound overall economy. Details of natural‑gas product prices for each user category are available on CPC’s global website under the natural‑gas price list, where the public can check the latest information.

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market surged today (31st) by 3,186.45 points, marking the biggest point gain in history. Foreign investors net bought NT$67.554 billion, investment trusts continued buying NT$33.382 billion, while proprietary traders still sold NT$16.26 billion, resulting in a combined net purchase of NT$84.676 billion by the three major institutional investors. On the last trading day of July, the Taiwan market jumped sharply and foreign investors made a substantial net purchase, lifting the gain to 3,186.45 points and narrowing the monthly net loss to 3,006.16 points. For the month, foreign investors’ net selling turned into a net purchase of NT$73.8926 billion.

Other electronics stocks sold included Sino‑Metal (1,550 shares), Delta Electronics (6,105 shares), Strongwell (7,867 shares), Winbond (6,622 shares), as well as Qibond, Quanta Computer, and Advantech each over 4,000 shares.

In addition, foreign investors sharply cut positions in the petrochemical sector, selling major components of Formosa Plastics Group: Formosa Plastics (14,500 shares), Formosa Chemical (9,623 shares), Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (8,349 shares), China Synthetic Fiber (11,300 shares), Hengtong (6,655 shares) and New Fiber (3,947 shares).

items.title: 這個產業即將進入強勁循環？從致茂法說找答案
items.title_en: Is This Industry About to Enter a Strong Cycle? Finding Answers from Zhi Mao's Investor Presentation
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 透過設備廠的法說會觀察產業動態及整體發展方向，是一種很好的方式。
設備通常會在客戶正式量產以前進入產線。客戶收到設備後，還要經過安裝、驗收、製程調整及試產，後續產品才會逐步增加出貨。
因此，搭配設備的出貨時程，就能往後推估客戶可能在什麼時間進入量產，以及相關供應鏈的營運動能何時開始轉強。
致茂的設備涵蓋AI伺服器電源、GPU與ASIC測試、先進封裝、光通訊、BBU及儲能系統等領域。
從公司這次法說會揭露的設備進度，可以進一步整理出AI供應鏈接下來的出貨節奏。
致茂(2360-TW)2026年第二季合併營收135.29億元，季增14%、年增110%，連續兩季創下歷史新高；上半年合併營收253.89億元，年增91%，每股盈餘21.27元。
從產品組合來看，上半年量測及自動化檢測設備營收115.59億元，年增136%；半導體與光通訊測試解決方案營收77.96億元，年增62%。
量測及自動化檢測設備成長最快，主要受到AI伺服器電源、HVDC及儲能系統測試需求帶動。
公司表示，AI相關需求已占電力電子測試營收約60%，大多與AI資料中心的電源供應器測試有關。
公布的財務數字可以告訴我們哪些客戶近期營運動能有望轉強；接下來再搭配新品的出貨進度，就能推估客戶何時開始增加出貨。

AI電源設備需求已經出現，客戶相關產品正進入出貨期
目前進度走得最前面的是AI伺服器電源。
此外，致茂下半年將推出3.6MW電網模擬器、2.7MW直流電子負載及1.8MW雙向直流電源，測試範圍已經從單一電源供應器，擴大到伺服器機櫃與伺服器集群。
搭配量測設備部門上半年營收年增136%，可以看出AI電源供應鏈已進入實際擴產階段。
接下來AI伺服器電源供應器、HVDC電源轉換設備以及整櫃電力系統供應商，如台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)等電源供應器大廠營運動能會比較快看到反映。

半導體後段測試客戶準備在2026年底至2027年產能爬坡
致茂的高功率老化測試設備已經接單，確定在2026年下半年出貨；公司也表示，多個GPU、CPU及交換器晶片客戶將在下半年推出新品或進行量產爬坡。
依照設備下半年進場的時間推估，相關晶片、封測及測試介面供應鏈的營運動能，較可能從2026年底至2027年增強。

BBU、儲能、光通訊測試設備下半年交付，相關供應鏈正在建置下一代新品產能
致茂的光引擎、CPO模組與雷射老化測試設備預計在2026年下半年出貨。
同一時間，最高可擴充至4MW的電池測試系統也將陸續交付，需求涵蓋資料中心BBU及ESS儲能。
BBU、電池模組、電池芯、EDLC、儲能系統整合商以及CPO相關供應鏈的營運動能較可能在2026年底至2027年逐步反映。

面板級封裝仍在客戶驗證
面板級先進封裝量測設備已安裝於客戶端，正在進行調整試用。
顯示面板級封裝距離大規模量產仍有變動空間。

致茂設備交付進度透露的客戶營運順序
從致茂法說會可以整理出AI供應鏈的目前的三個營運狀態：
AI電源相關供應鏈已經進入擴產與出貨，成長動能正在發生。
半導體後段測試、光通訊、BBU及儲能客戶正在逐步新增、建置產能，營運較可能在2026年底至2027年轉強。
面板級封裝客戶仍在進行驗證，相關產品量產仍有待觀察。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Observing industry dynamics and overall development direction through equipment manufacturers' investor presentations is a very effective method.

Equipment typically enters the production line before a customer begins mass production. After receiving the equipment, the customer must go through installation, acceptance, process adjustment and trial production before the product shipments gradually increase.

Therefore, by aligning equipment shipment schedules, one can estimate when customers are likely to start mass production and when the related supply chain’s operational momentum will begin to strengthen.
Zhi Mao's equipment covers AI server power supplies, GPU and ASIC testing, advanced packaging, optical communications, BBU and energy storage systems, among others.
From the equipment progress disclosed at the company’s recent presentation, we can further map out the upcoming shipment rhythm of the AI supply chain.

Zhi Mao (2360‑TW) reported Q2 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$13.529 billion, up 14% quarter‑over‑quarter and 110% year‑over‑year, marking a second consecutive record high; H1 consolidated revenue was NT$25.389 billion, up 91% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$21.27.

By product mix, H1 revenue from measurement and automated inspection equipment was NT$11.559 billion, up 136% YoY; revenue from semiconductor and optical communication test solutions was NT$7.796 billion, up 62% YoY.
Measurement and automated inspection equipment grew the fastest, driven mainly by demand for AI server power supplies, HVDC and energy‑storage system testing.
The company said AI‑related demand now accounts for about 60% of its power‑electronics test revenue, largely tied to power‑supply testing for AI data‑center servers.

The disclosed financial numbers indicate which customers’ operations may soon strengthen; combined with the rollout schedule of new products, we can infer when customers will start increasing shipments.
Demand for AI power equipment has already materialized, and related customer products are entering the shipment phase.
The AI server power supply segment is currently the furthest ahead in progress.

In addition, Zhi Mao will launch a 3.6 MW grid simulator, a 2.7 MW DC electronic load and a 1.8 MW bidirectional DC power supply in the second half of the year, expanding test coverage from single power supplies to server racks and server clusters.
Coupled with a 136% YoY increase in H1 revenue for the measurement equipment division, it is clear that the AI power‑supply chain has entered a genuine expansion phase.

Going forward, AI server power supplies, HVDC power‑conversion equipment and full‑rack power system providers such as Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and Lite‑On (2301‑TW) are likely to see operational momentum reflected relatively quickly.
Semiconductor back‑end test customers are preparing for capacity ramp‑up from late 2026 to 2027

Zhi Mao’s high‑power aging test equipment has already received orders for shipment in H2 2026; the company also said several GPU, CPU and switch‑chip customers will launch new products or ramp up volume production in the second half of the year.
Based on the timing of equipment arrivals in H2, the operational momentum of related chip, packaging and test‑interface supply chains is expected to strengthen from late 2026 into 2027.
BBU, energy‑storage and optical‑communication test equipment will be delivered in H2, and the related supply chain is building next‑generation product capacity
Zhi Mao’s optical engine, CPO modules and laser aging test equipment are slated for H2 2026 shipment.
At the same time, battery test systems scalable up to 4 MW will be delivered sequentially, serving data‑center BBUs and ESS storage needs.
The operational momentum of BBU, battery modules, cells, EDLCs, storage‑system integrators and CPO‑related supply chains is likely to gradually manifest from late 2026 to 2027.
Panel‑level packaging is still under customer verification
Panel‑level advanced packaging measurement equipment has been installed at the customer site and is undergoing adjustment trials.
Display panel‑level packaging still has room for change before large‑scale mass production.
Customer operational sequence revealed by Zhi Mao’s equipment delivery schedule
From Zhi Mao’s presentation we can outline three current operational states in the AI supply chain:
AI power‑related supply chain has entered expansion and shipment, with growth momentum now unfolding.
Semiconductor back‑end test, optical‑communication, BBU and energy‑storage customers are gradually adding and building capacity, with operations likely to strengthen from late 2026 to 2027.
Panel‑level packaging customers remain in verification, and mass production of related products is still to be observed.

items.title: 再等恐付出更大代價！Fed反對票官員公開要求升息
items.title_en: Waiting Longer May Cost More! Fed Dissenters Publicly Call for Rate Hikes
paras: 本周反對聯準會 (Fed) 維持利率不變的 3 名官員周五 (31 日) 表示，現在就應採取升息行動，以防通膨進一步惡化，強調及早小幅調整政策，可避免日後被迫採取更激烈的緊縮措施。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 在聲明中表示，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 現在應該採取行動，加速個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數回到 2% 目標，履行維護物價穩定的承諾。她警告，通膨維持高檔的時間愈久，未來壓低通膨的難度與代價就愈高。
明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 也認為，現階段採取一連串小幅升息，會比持續等待、最終不得不祭出更大幅度行動來得理想。
卡什卡里與哈瑪克本周加入達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根 (Lorie Logan) 的行列，反對維持利率不變。FOMC 其餘 9 名具投票權官員則支持按兵不動，將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%。在 2025 年下半年連續降息 3 次後，Fed 今年以來始終未調整利率。
美國通膨超過 Fed 的 2% 目標已逾 5 年，今年又受到美伊戰爭及川普政府關稅政策影響而再度升溫。雖然中東緊張情勢短暫降溫，帶動 6 月物價漲勢放緩，但能源價格再度走高，市場擔心 Fed 最終仍須收緊貨幣政策。
Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 雖投票支持維持利率不變，但強調讓通膨回到目標的決心沒有動搖。他表示，長達 5 年多的通膨超標問題，不可能在 9 周內或僅憑單月物價小幅下降就獲得解決。
哈瑪克則直言，她沒有信心通膨會自行回落至目標。除了能源價格等供給面因素外，需求面也持續帶來物價壓力。克里夫蘭地區企業反映，漲價壓力正在擴大而非消退，消費者也對物價長期居高不下感到絕望。
卡什卡里表示，貨幣政策除了處理需求帶動的通膨，也應因應接連發生的供給衝擊，避免高通膨預期變得根深柢固。蘿根預計稍晚發表聲明，說明投下反對票的理由。
paras_en: Three Fed officials who voted against keeping rates unchanged this week said on Friday (the 31st) that the central bank should raise rates now to prevent inflation from worsening further, stressing that a modest early adjustment could avoid the need for more aggressive tightening later.

Beth Hammack, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, said in a statement that the Federal Open Market Committee should act now to accelerate the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index back toward its 2% target and fulfill its price‑stability mandate. She warned that the longer inflation stays high, the harder and more costly it will be to bring it down.

Neel Kashkari, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, also argued that a series of small rate hikes at this stage would be preferable to waiting and eventually being forced to take a larger‑scale action.

Kashkari and Hammack joined Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan this week in voting against holding rates steady. The other nine voting members of the FOMC supported keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.5%‑3.75%. After three consecutive cuts in the second half of 2025, the Fed has not changed rates at all this year.

U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% goal for more than five years and was reignited this year by the Israel‑Iran conflict and tariffs imposed by the Trump administration. Although Middle‑East tensions eased briefly, slowing June price gains, energy prices have risen again, prompting markets to worry that the Fed will ultimately have to tighten monetary policy.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who voted to keep rates unchanged, stressed that his resolve to bring inflation back to target remains firm. He said the more‑than‑five‑year period of elevated inflation cannot be solved in nine weeks or by a modest one‑month dip in prices.

Hammack said she lacks confidence that inflation will fall back to target on its own. In addition to supply‑side factors such as energy prices, demand‑side pressures continue to push prices up. Businesses in the Cleveland area report that price‑increase pressure is expanding rather than receding, and consumers are despairing over persistently high prices.

Kashkari added that monetary policy should address not only demand‑driven inflation but also the series of supply shocks, to prevent high‑inflation expectations from becoming entrenched. Logan is expected to issue a statement later explaining the reasons for her dissenting vote.

items.title: 特斯拉中國導入「豆包」大型語言模型 強化座艙在地化語音互動體驗
items.title_en: Tesla China Introduces ByteDance's "Doubao" Large Language Model to Enhance Localized In‑Cabin Voice Interaction
paras: 特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 中國 7 月 31 日公布了 2026.14.13 版本的車用軟體更新，涵蓋 Model 3、Model Y、Model S、Model X 車型，代表公司正式導入由字節跳動 (ByteDance) 開發的「豆包」大型語言模型 (LLM)。此舉被視為特斯拉強化中國市場在地化體驗、提升座艙競爭力的重要進展。
據指出，這項 AI 功能主要針對搭載 HW 3.0 或更早版本硬體的車型，而非最新的 AI4 硬體。此外，車主必須訂閱「高級車載娛樂服務」(Premium Connectivity)，目前在中國市場的訂閱費用為每月 9.99 元人民幣。
更新後的智慧語音助手不僅能提供即時資訊，還具備自然流暢的對話能力。特斯拉官方在社群媒體上指出，該助手具備唱歌、說故事及辯論等多元互動模式，並提供「萬事通」、「音樂愛好者」等多種個性化角色供選擇。
然而，現階段「豆包」助手僅限於資訊交互權限，相關助手目前尚無法直接控制車窗、空調等車輛硬體功能。當地評論人士認為，這體現了車企對行車安全的底線，車輛控制涉及核心操控安全，需經過更嚴苛的測試驗證，因此特斯拉採取了「引入本土模型補足互動短板，同時保留核心控制權」的折衷方案。
《CnEVPost》報導分析，中國本土電動車廠早已將 AI 語音助手視為標準配備，相比之下，特斯拉的座艙互動能力長期以來被視為弱點；此次合作是特斯拉推動座艙體驗在地化的實質性舉措。
對於字節跳動而言，這次合作意味著其大模型業務正式闖入「智慧座艙」這一黃金賽道。文章作者觀察到，字節跳動內部正透過整合「飛書」與「豆包」團隊，試圖打通 C 端消費場景與 B 端辦公應用，加速 AI 的商用落地。
除「豆包」外，特斯拉也曾披露與 DeepSeek 的合作，由後者負責 AI 閒聊功能。同時，報導指出阿里巴巴的「通義千問」(Qwen) 大型語言模型已進入深度測試階段，未來可能實現包括車輛控制與導航在內的更深層功能。
而在北美市場，特斯拉則持續使用由 Elon Musk 旗下 xAI 開發的 Grok 模型。這顯示特斯拉在全球不同市場採取了差異化的 AI 在地化策略，以應對各國語言與用戶習慣的挑戰。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) China announced on July 31 a vehicle‑software update (version 2026.14.13) covering Model 3, Model Y, Model S and Model X, marking the company’s formal adoption of ByteDance’s "Doubao" large language model (LLM). The move is seen as a key step for Tesla to strengthen its localized experience in the Chinese market and boost cabin competitiveness.

The AI feature is aimed at vehicles equipped with HW 3.0 or earlier hardware, not the newest AI4 hardware. Owners must subscribe to the Premium Connectivity service, which in China currently costs RMB 9.99 per month.

The upgraded smart voice assistant can provide real‑time information and engage in natural, fluid conversation. Tesla’s official social‑media post highlighted that the assistant can sing, tell stories, debate and offers multiple personalized personas such as "Jack‑of‑all‑trades" and "Music Lover" for users to choose from.

At present the "Doubao" assistant is limited to information‑exchange permissions and cannot directly control windows, climate or other vehicle hardware. Local commentators say this reflects automakers’ safety bottom line—vehicle control involves core safety functions that require stricter testing—so Tesla opted for a compromise: introduce a domestic model to fill interaction gaps while retaining core control rights.

According to CnEVPost, Chinese EV makers have long treated AI voice assistants as standard equipment, whereas Tesla’s cabin interaction has historically been viewed as a weakness; this partnership represents a substantive step toward localizing Tesla’s cabin experience.

For ByteDance, the deal signals its large‑model business entering the lucrative "smart cabin" arena. The article notes that ByteDance is integrating its Feishu and Doubao teams to bridge consumer (C‑end) scenarios with enterprise (B‑end) applications, accelerating commercial AI deployment.

In addition to Doubao, Tesla has disclosed a collaboration with DeepSeek, which handles AI chit‑chat functions. The report also mentions that Alibaba’s Qwen large language model is in deep‑testing phase and may later support deeper functions such as vehicle control and navigation.

In the North American market, Tesla continues to use the Grok model developed by Elon Musk’s xAI, illustrating Tesla’s differentiated AI localization strategy across regions to address language and user‑habit challenges.

items.title: Bloom Energy 進入爆發階段！看懂核心驅動力，才能掌握下一步
items.title_en: Bloom Energy Enters Explosive Growth Phase! Understanding the Core Drivers Is Key to the Next Step
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 自從 Bloom Energy (BE-US) 在 2024 年切入 AI 資料中心市場後，市場對公司未來訂單的預期幾乎全面翻轉。
根據 Visible Alpha 預估，Bloom Energy 的 100kW 燃料電池系統部署量，將由 2025 年約 4,477 套，大幅增加至 2030 年約 41,046 套，2032 年更進一步來到 45,027 套，七年間成長約 10 倍。
不過，這樣的預估也帶來一個值得思考的問題。
這樣一路向上的成長預期，沒有出現明顯的週期循環，是否合理？

Bloom Energy 的爆發關鍵
過去 Bloom Energy 主要提供企業、醫院、電信商及工廠等分散式發電系統，但真正讓市場重新認識它，是 AI 資料中心快速興建所帶來的新需求。
2024 年 7 月，公司宣布 CoreWeave 採用 Bloom Energy 作為 AI 資料中心現場供電方案，這也是他第一個公開的大型 AI 資料中心案例。
此後不到一年，便快速取得更多大型客戶，目前美國主要 Hyperscaler 幾乎都已完成方案驗證，AI 已成為公司最重要的新成長引擎。
從 S&P Global 最新預估來看，2025 年，美國 Hyperscale、租賃型及加密貨幣資料中心的電網用電需求已達約 64.4 GW，較前一年增加25%；到了2030年，預估將進一步增加至約 183.2 GW，五年間接近成長三倍。
然而，資料中心可以在一至兩年內完成規畫與建設，新的發電設施與輸電工程卻無法以相同速度上線。
即使美國聯邦能源管理委員會已透過 FERC Order 2023 推動併網改革，截至2026年，從專案進入排隊到預計商轉的平均時間，仍約為 53至59個月，相當於接近五年。部分壅塞較嚴重的市場，等待時間甚至更長。
也因此，越來越多資料中心開發商不再完全等待公用電網，而是採用「自帶電力」（Bring Your Own Power，BYOP）模式，直接在資料中心現場配置天然氣發電機組、燃料電池與儲能設備，以換取更快的上線時間。
簡單來說，Bloom Energy 受惠的核心，其實是 AI 資料中心帶來的供電缺口。

這樣的供電缺口會持續多久？
從 S&P Global 的併網（Interconnection Queue）資料，可以看到美國未來幾年的供電變化。
目前已知已簽署併網協議（IA）的併網排隊容量中，超過四分之三（約 225 GW）預計將於 2026 至 2028 年間投入商業運轉。
其中，2027 年預計有超過 84 GW 開始向電網送電，2028 年則預計再新增約 75 GW。
整體來看，預計在 2030 年前投入商業運轉的已簽約容量將超過 300 GW。
也就是說，目前 AI 建設最急迫的供電缺口，很可能集中在 2026 年。
隨著大量新電力於 2027～2028 年開始投入，供電壓力有機會逐步改善。

下一步：關注訂單性質的改變
備援電力需求本來就是 Bloom Energy 的長期驅動力，未來仍會占有一定比重。
2026 年資料中心建置需求最旺，同時也是新增電力尚未完全到位的關鍵時點，因此公司今年訂單強勁，沒有疑問。
不過，需要留意的是，後續需求的性質有沒有可能開始改變。
在目前供電最吃緊的階段，企業最重視的是盡快取得電力，因此現場發電設備屬於具有高度急迫性的建置需求。
但當大量新電力逐漸投入後，Bloom Energy 的角色，是否會從立即補足供電缺口，逐漸轉向提升供電韌性與備援能力，就是未來值得觀察的重點。
