※ 免責聲明：文中所提的個股、基金、期貨商品內容僅供參考，並非投資建議，投資人應獨立判斷，審慎評估風險。
paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Since Bloom Energy (BE-US) entered the AI data‑center market in 2024, expectations for the company’s future orders have essentially flipped upside down.

According to Visible Alpha’s forecast, deployments of Bloom Energy’s 100 kW fuel‑cell systems will rise from about 4,477 units in 2025 to roughly 41,046 units by 2030, and further to 45,027 units in 2032 – an increase of about ten‑fold over seven years.
However, that forecast raises a question worth pondering: Is such a continuously upward growth expectation, without a clear cyclical pattern, reasonable?
Bloom Energy’s Explosive Trigger

Historically, Bloom Energy mainly supplied distributed power systems to enterprises, hospitals, telecom operators and factories, but the market’s renewed recognition of the company stems from the new demand generated by the rapid construction of AI data centers.

In July 2024, the company announced that CoreWeave would use Bloom Energy as the on‑site power solution for its AI data center – the first publicly disclosed large‑scale AI data‑center case for Bloom.
In less than a year, Bloom quickly secured more large customers; today, most major U.S. hyperscalers have completed solution validation, making AI the company’s most important new growth engine.

S&P Global’s latest estimate shows that in 2025 U.S. hyperscale, colocation and cryptocurrency data centers will demand about 64.4 GW of grid power, a 25% increase over the prior year; by 2030 the demand is projected to rise to roughly 183.2 GW, nearly tripling in five years.
Yet data‑center planning and construction can be completed within one to two years, while new generation facilities and transmission projects cannot be brought online at the same pace.

Even though the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has pushed interconnection reforms through FERC Order 2023, the average time from project queue entry to expected commercial operation remains about 53 to 59 months as of 2026 – roughly five years, with even longer waits in the most congested markets.

Consequently, an increasing number of data‑center developers are no longer waiting solely for the public grid; they are adopting a “Bring Your Own Power” (BYOP) model, installing on‑site natural‑gas generators, fuel cells and storage to achieve faster commissioning.
In short, the core benefit to Bloom Energy is the power‑supply gap created by AI data centers.
How Long Will This Power‑Supply Gap Last?
Interconnection queue data from S&P Global shows the upcoming changes in U.S. power supply.
Of the interconnection queue capacity already under signed interconnection agreements (IA), more than three‑quarters – about 225 GW – is slated to enter commercial operation between 2026 and 2028.
Specifically, over 84 GW is expected to start feeding the grid in 2027, with an additional roughly 75 GW in 2028.
Overall, signed capacity projected to be operational before 2030 will exceed 300 GW.
Thus, the most urgent power‑supply gap for AI construction is likely concentrated in 2026, with pressure expected to ease as large amounts of new power come online in 2027‑2028.
Next Step: Watch for Changes in Order Types
Backup power demand has always been a long‑term driver for Bloom Energy and will continue to represent a significant share of its business.
2026 is the peak year for data‑center build‑out and also the critical point when new power is not yet fully in place, so strong orders this year are unsurprising.
However, it is worth monitoring whether the nature of future demand will shift.
During the current tight‑supply phase, enterprises prioritize securing power quickly, making on‑site generation a highly urgent need.

When abundant new power gradually becomes available, the question will be whether Bloom Energy’s role transitions from immediately filling the power gap to enhancing power resilience and backup capability – a key trend to watch going forward.

items.title: 蘋果財測爆冷！盤前股價重挫逾7% 市值恐蒸發3616億美元
items.title_en: Apple Forecast Shock: Pre‑market Stock Drops Over 7%, Market Value Could Lose $361.6 Billion
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 周五 (31 日) 盤前股價重挫逾 7%，主因公司警告先進晶片產能不足將拖累成長前景，促使投資人將焦點轉向供應瓶頸，以及預期中的 iPhone 漲價是否會打擊需求。若跌幅維持不變，蘋果市值恐一口氣蒸發約 3,616 億美元。
截稿前，蘋果周五盤前股價下跌 7.76%，每股暫報 307.54 美元。
蘋果周四表示，先進晶片製造產能短缺，正限制 iPhone、Mac 及部分 iPad 的供應。執行長庫克強調，較疲弱的財測並非源自需求不振，而是產品供應受到限制。隨著 AI 熱潮推升先進晶片及記憶體需求，科技業供應日益吃緊，不僅帶動成本上漲，也使供應鏈瓶頸延續。
蘋果預估，本季營收將成長 9% 至 11%，低於華爾街預期的約 12%；iPhone 營收估計將成長約 15% 至 19%，同樣不及分析師預測。不過，蘋果會計年度第三季 iPhone 銷售額仍年增 21.7% 至 542.5 億美元，高於市場預估的 538.6 億美元，創下歷來同期最佳紀錄，顯示終端需求依然強勁。
摩根大通分析師查特吉 (Samik Chatterjee) 團隊指出，蘋果強勁需求正撞上供應及成本挑戰，但供應限制較可能只是延後銷售，而非讓需求消失，相關營收有望在未來幾季實現。
市場普遍預期蘋果將於今年稍晚調高 iPhone 售價，投資人關注漲價是否會削弱需求。TD Cowen 分析師認為，新一輪 iPhone 產品周期、AI 版 Siri 功能及蘋果升級方案，可望讓公司在不造成需求明顯下滑的情況下提高價格。
此外，庫克將於 9 月初卸下執行長職務，由硬體工程主管特納斯 (John Ternus) 接棒，為帶領蘋果成為全球市值最高企業之一的庫克時代畫下句點。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) saw its pre‑market share plunge more than 7% on Friday (the 31st), mainly because the company warned that a shortage of advanced chip capacity will weigh on its growth outlook, prompting investors to focus on supply bottlenecks and whether the expected iPhone price hike will dent demand. If the decline holds, Apple’s market value could evaporate about $361.6 billion in one swoop.
At the time of writing, Apple’s pre‑market price on Friday was down 7.76%, briefly reporting $307.54 per share.

Apple said on Thursday that a shortage of advanced chip manufacturing capacity is constraining supply of iPhones, Macs and some iPads. CEO Tim Cook stressed that the weaker forecast stems not from soft demand but from product supply limits. As the AI boom drives up demand for advanced chips and memory, the tech sector’s supply is tightening, pushing up costs and extending supply‑chain bottlenecks.

Apple projects this quarter’s revenue to grow 9%‑11%, below Wall Street’s roughly 12% expectation; iPhone revenue is estimated to rise about 15%‑19%, also missing analysts’ forecasts. However, Apple’s fiscal third‑quarter iPhone sales are still expected to increase 21.7% year‑over‑year to $54.25 billion, above the market estimate of $53.86 billion, marking the best record for the period and showing that end‑user demand remains strong.

JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee’s team noted that Apple’s strong demand is hitting supply and cost challenges, but the supply constraints are more likely to delay sales rather than eliminate demand, so related revenue could materialize over the next few quarters.

The market broadly expects Apple to raise iPhone prices later this year, and investors are watching whether a price hike will weaken demand. TD Cowen analysts believe a new iPhone product cycle, AI‑enhanced Siri features and Apple’s upgrade programs could allow the company to raise prices without a noticeable drop in demand.

In addition, Cook will step down as CEO in early September, handing the role to hardware engineering chief John Ternus, marking the end of the Cook era that led Apple to become one of the world’s most valuable companies.

items.title: 美商務部宣布撥款8.74億美元給7家科技公司 並要求股權回報
items.title_en: U.S. Commerce Department Announces $874 Million Funding for Seven Tech Companies, Requires Equity Returns
paras: 美國商務部於當地 29 日宣布，根據《晶片與科學法案》(CHIPS and Science Act)，已與 7 家半導體相關企業簽署初步意向書，擬提供總額高達 8.74 億美元的聯邦激勵資金。
這筆資金旨在強化美國國內半導體研發能力，特別聚焦於解決人工智慧 (AI) 及高效能運算 (HPC) 系統的瓶頸，包括積體光子學、先進封裝及新型運算架構等領域。
此次撥款政策出現重大轉向，美國商務部要求作為獲得資金的條件，政府將取得各受補助公司的少數、非控股股權，以確保納稅人能從企業未來的增值中獲得回報。商務部指出，這項安排是為了讓公共資金發揮類似「投資組合」的作用，而不僅是單向補貼。
然而，專家與部分市場人士對此模式持保留態度。反對者認為，政府持股可能導致產業政策、監管權力與企業經營之間的邊界模糊，甚至影響企業在國際市場的決策獨立性。商務部也強調，目前簽署的僅為意向書，最終獎勵金額與細節仍需視後續的盡職調查與正式協議完成而定。
在受惠企業中，以晶圓代工大廠格羅方德 (GlobalFoundries) 獲得金額最高，預計獲撥 3 億美元用於研發「共封裝光學」(Co-packaged Optics, CPO) 技術。
商務部表示，此技術透過光訊號取代傳統銅線傳輸數據，能顯著提升運算速度並改善能耗，預計將相關研發進度提前二至三年。
AI 記憶體公司 Kepler 則獲配 2.45 億美元，擬開發結合三維 (3D) 整合與鐵電材料的新型存儲技術，旨在緩解 AI 系統中常見的「記憶體牆」(Memory Wall) 問題。此外，半導體設備商 Multibeam Corporation 獲撥 1.4 億美元，用於研發能實現數千條高速連接的先進封裝技術，支持異質整合 (Chiplet) 設計。
其餘獲資助的企業包含：
Extropic：獲 7,500 萬美元研發熱力學概率運算技術。
Thintronics：獲 5,000 萬美元開發用於高速互連的低損耗介電材料。
OBSIDIA Semiconductors：獲 3,400 萬美元研發非侵入式假冒元器件偵測系統，強化供應鏈安全。
Aeluma：獲 3,000 萬美元開發用於 AI 光互連的大尺寸光子基板技術。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce announced on the 29th that, under the CHIPS and Science Act, it has signed preliminary memoranda of understanding with seven semiconductor‑related companies to provide up to $874 million in federal incentive funding.

The money is intended to strengthen domestic semiconductor research and development, with a particular focus on addressing bottlenecks in artificial‑intelligence (AI) and high‑performance computing (HPC) systems, including integrated photonics, advanced packaging and new computing architectures.

The funding policy marks a major shift: as a condition for receiving the money, the Commerce Department will take a small, non‑controlling equity stake in each recipient company to ensure taxpayers share in the firms’ future upside. The department said the arrangement is meant to make public money function like a "portfolio" investment rather than a one‑way subsidy.

Experts and some market participants, however, expressed reservations. Critics argue that government equity could blur the lines between industrial policy, regulatory authority and corporate management, and could even affect companies’ decision‑making independence in international markets. The Commerce Department also stressed that only the letters of intent have been signed; the final award amounts and details will depend on subsequent due‑diligence and formal agreements.
Among the beneficiaries, wafer‑fab giant GlobalFoundries will receive the largest award, with $300 million earmarked for research on Co‑Packaged Optics (CPO) technology.

The department said the technology replaces traditional copper interconnects with optical signals, which can dramatically boost compute speed and improve energy efficiency, and is expected to accelerate the related R&D timeline by two to three years.

AI memory company Kepler will receive $245 million to develop a new storage technology that combines three‑dimensional integration with ferroelectric materials, aimed at alleviating the "memory wall" problem common in AI systems. Semiconductor equipment maker Multibeam Corporation will be allocated $140 million for advanced packaging research that can support thousands of high‑speed connections, enabling heterogeneous chiplet integration.
The remaining funded companies are:
Extropic: $75 million to develop thermodynamic probabilistic computing technology.
Thintronics: $50 million to develop low‑loss dielectric materials for high‑speed interconnects.
OBSIDIA Semiconductors: $34 million to develop non‑intrusive counterfeit component detection systems, strengthening supply‑chain security.
Aeluma: $30 million to develop large‑area photonic substrate technology for AI optical interconnects.

items.title: 內部人大舉賣股 看空程度創21年之最！專家：股市遲早受重力效應拖累
items.title_en: Insiders Dump Shares in Record Bearishness – Worst in 21 Years! Experts Warn Market Will Eventually Feel Gravity Drag
paras: 企業內部人士對股市的看法，正處於逾 20 年來最悲觀水準，專家指出，市場遲早可能受到這股看空情緒拖累。
企業內部人士通常比一般投資人更了解自家公司前景，因此他們買賣股票的行為向來被視為重要風向球。今年 7 月，這批人出售自家公司股票的規模遠高於買進。
美國密西根大學財務金融教授、內部人交易研究權威 Nejat Seyhun 指出，他偏好的內部人情緒指標，是計算企業高階主管與董事出現「淨買進」的公司家數，占所有曾發生買賣交易公司的比率：截至 7 月最後一個交易的周三為止，該指標僅 14.8%，若到 7 月底仍維持此水準，將創至少 21 年來最低紀錄。
更令人擔憂的是，Seyhun 研究發現，若內部人大量賣股發生在股市下跌期間，往往是更強烈的利空訊號。這代表企業內部人士普遍認為，股市短期內難以快速反彈，因此沒有必要等待更高價格再出售持股。
7 月以來，美股表現疲弱，費城半導體指數更一度跌入技術性熊市。

內部人看空情緒已持續數年

Seyhun 父子創辦的研究網站 InsiderSentiment.com 資料顯示，企業內部人情緒近年持續轉弱。過去三年來的大多數月份，內部人情緒指標都低於歷史平均值。
儘管如此，美股面對內部人大量賣股仍展現驚人韌性，因此至少目前為止，內部人的悲觀看法仍屬「過早」。
然而 Nejat Seyhun 認為，股市遲早仍將受到這股內部人看空情緒的「重力效應」影響，而且發生時間可能比市場預期更早。

大型股內部人最悲觀

在整體偏空氛圍下，民生必需品是少數內部人近期轉為偏多的產業。但這也未必是好消息，理由是民生必需品屬防禦型類股，通常只有在市場即將走弱時，才會出現相對優異表現。
除了民生必需品以外，目前只有原物料與公用事業兩大類股出現內部人淨買進。
值得注意的是，企業內部人士對大型股尤其悲觀。7 月曾出現內部人買賣交易的大型股中，僅 3.2% 的公司呈現淨買進，其餘幾乎全數為淨賣出。
paras_en: Corporate insiders' outlook on the stock market is now at its most pessimistic level in over 20 years, and experts say the market will eventually be weighed down by this bearish sentiment.

Insiders typically know their own companies better than ordinary investors, so their buying and selling has long been viewed as a key barometer. In July, the volume of shares they sold far exceeded the amount they bought.

Nejat Seyhun, a finance professor at the University of Michigan and a leading authority on insider trading, says his preferred insider‑sentiment gauge is the proportion of firms whose senior executives and directors show a net purchase, out of all firms that have any insider trades. As of the last trading Wednesday in July, that gauge was only 14.8%; if it stays at that level through the end of July, it will mark the lowest reading in at least 21 years.

Even more concerning, Seyhun’s research finds that when large insider sell‑offs occur during market declines, they tend to be an especially strong negative signal. It suggests insiders broadly believe the market cannot rebound quickly in the short term, so there is no need to wait for higher prices before unloading shares.
Since July, U.S. equities have been sluggish, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index even slipped into a technical bear market at one point.
Bearish insider sentiment has persisted for several years

Data from InsiderSentiment.com, the research site founded by Seyhun and his son, show that insider sentiment has been weakening in recent years. For most months over the past three years, the insider‑sentiment gauge has been below its historical average.
Nevertheless, U.S. stocks have shown surprising resilience despite the wave of insider selling, so for now the bearish view of insiders may still be "premature."
Seyhun, however, believes the market will eventually feel the "gravity effect" of this insider bearishness, and that it could hit sooner than the market expects.
Large‑cap insiders are the most pessimistic

Within the overall bearish backdrop, consumer staples are one of the few sectors where insiders have recently turned slightly bullish. That may not be a good sign, because consumer staples are defensive stocks that typically only outperform when the broader market is about to weaken.
Aside from consumer staples, only two other sectors – materials and utilities – have seen net insider buying.

It is worth noting that insiders are especially gloomy about large‑cap stocks. Of the large‑cap companies that saw insider trades in July, only 3.2% recorded net purchases, with the overwhelming majority showing net sales.

items.title: 砸41.5億強攻企業AI！繼微軟後OpenAI成立FDE「特種部隊」攜手BCG、貝恩構築頂級顧問網絡
items.title_en: Spending $4.15 Billion to Attack Enterprise AI! After Microsoft, OpenAI Launches FDE “Special Forces” and Teams Up with BCG, Bain to Build a Top‑Tier Consulting Network
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，在消費級 AI 應用趨於飽和之際，OpenAI 正以前所未有的力道轉向企業級市場，試圖填補尖端模型能力與企業實際應用之間的巨大鴻溝。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周五 (31 日) 報導，OpenAI 近期連出兩記重拳：成立獨立服務子公司「OpenAI Deployment Co.」(簡稱 DeployCo)，並斥資 1.5 億美元構建頂級諮詢夥伴網絡，雙管齊下搶占數千億美元的企業 AI 服務市場。
DeployCo 在 5 月正式掛牌，由 TPG 領投 40 億美元，Advent、貝恩資本、Brookfield 等巨頭聯合參投。該公司脫胎於 OpenAI 對 AI 諮詢公司 Tomoro 及應用開發商 Northslope 的連續收購，目前已集結數百名「前線部署工程師」(FDE)。這支被視為「特種部隊」的隊伍，將直接進駐企業客戶現場，將抽象的模型能力轉化為具體的業務流程。
DeployCo 技術長 Arnaud Fournier 說：「模型能力與人們實際使用之間的差距，從未像現在這樣巨大。」
以西班牙對外銀行 (BBVA) 為例，一名 FDE 協助該行重構信貸風險分析工具，引入 AI 智能體互評機制，使工具準確率從不足 60% 躍升至 80%。
OpenAI 內部 FDE 負責人 Colin Jarvis 指出，FDE 團隊通常嵌入客戶數月至數年，規模從一人到五人不等，涵蓋從概念驗證到全面部署的全週期。
然而，技術落地僅是難題的一半。顧能 (Gartner) 分析師 Arun Chandrasekaran 指出，AI 實驗室缺乏與董事會及「長字輩」高管對話的管道，難以推動深層次的組織變革。
因此，OpenAI 同步推出 1.5 億美元的合作夥伴計劃，將波士頓諮詢 (BCG)、貝恩、埃森哲等頂級諮詢巨頭納入生態系。
BCG 全球合作與聯盟負責人 Vikas Taneja 強調，諮詢公司的核心價值在於協助企業應對「變革管理」，像是如何調整組織架構、重塑工作流程、管理員工預期，以承接 AI 帶來的效率飛躍。
OpenAI 全球合作與生態副總裁 Colleen Kapase 說：「將先進模型轉化為真實業務價值，需要一個值得信賴的夥伴生態系統。」
TPG 合夥人 Peter McGoohan 預測，企業 AI 服務的可尋址市場規模最終將達數千億美元。
這場競賽已趨於白熱化。Anthropic 在 3 月推出類似的「應用 AI 團隊」及夥伴計畫，微軟與亞馬遜也相繼佈局 FDE 服務。
對於剛完成新一輪融資、亟需證明商業化能力的 OpenAI 而言，DeployCo 及其夥伴網絡不僅是技術落地的抓手，更是支撐其天價估值、對抗競爭對手的戰略護城河。企業 AI 的「最後一哩路」正成為巨頭們角力的新戰場。
paras_en: Foreign media reports note that as consumer‑grade AI applications approach saturation, OpenAI is shifting to the enterprise market with unprecedented force, aiming to bridge the huge gap between cutting‑edge model capabilities and real‑world business use.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (the 31st) that OpenAI has dealt two heavy blows recently: it created an independent services subsidiary called OpenAI Deployment Co. (shortened to DeployCo) and is spending $150 million to build a top‑tier consulting partner network, a two‑pronged effort to capture the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar enterprise AI services market.

DeployCo was officially launched in May, backed by a $4 billion lead investment from TPG, with Advent, Bain Capital, Brookfield and other giants co‑investing. The company emerged from OpenAI’s successive acquisitions of AI consulting firm Tomoro and application developer Northslope, and now has assembled hundreds of “Front‑line Deployment Engineers” (FDE). This team, described as a “special forces” unit, will go on‑site at corporate customers to turn abstract model capabilities into concrete business processes.
DeployCo’s chief technology officer Arnaud Fournier said, “The gap between model capabilities and what people actually use has never been this large.”

Taking Spain’s Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) as an example, an FDE helped the bank revamp its credit‑risk analysis tool, introducing an AI‑agent peer‑review mechanism that lifted the tool’s accuracy from under 60 % to 80 %.

OpenAI’s internal FDE head Colin Jarvis noted that FDE teams typically embed with clients for months to years, ranging in size from one to five people, covering the full cycle from proof‑of‑concept to full deployment.

However, technology deployment is only half the challenge. Gartner analyst Arun Chandrasekaran pointed out that AI labs often lack channels to communicate with boards and senior‑level executives, making deep organizational change difficult to drive.
Therefore, OpenAI is simultaneously launching a $150 million partner program, bringing top consulting giants such as Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain, and Accenture into its ecosystem.

BCG’s global head of partnerships and alliances Vikas Taneja emphasized that a consulting firm’s core value lies in helping companies manage “change management”—adjusting organizational structures, redesigning workflows, and managing employee expectations to capture AI‑driven efficiency gains.
OpenAI’s vice‑president of global partnerships and ecosystem Colleen Kapase said, “Turning advanced models into real business value requires a trustworthy partner ecosystem.”
TPG partner Peter McGoohan predicts that the addressable market for enterprise AI services will ultimately reach several hundred billion dollars.
The race has heated up. Anthropic launched a similar “Application AI Team” and partner program in March, and Microsoft and Amazon have also rolled out FDE services.

For OpenAI, which has just completed a new financing round and is eager to prove its commercialization chops, DeployCo and its partner network are not only a means to implement technology but also a strategic moat supporting its sky‑high valuation and defending against rivals. The “last mile” of enterprise AI is becoming the new battlefield for the giants.

items.title: 慧榮與聯發科下周主題演講 聚焦新一代AI車用平台
items.title_en: Simo and MediaTek to Deliver Joint Keynote Next Week Focusing on Next‑Generation AI‑Ready Automotive Platform
paras: 慧榮科技 (SIMO-US) 今 (31) 日宣布，將與聯發科 (2454-TW) 於 FMS 2026 主題演講中，聚焦新一代 AI-Ready 車用平台。此次主題演講將結合聯發科最新車載座艙平台與慧榮先進的車用儲存技術，說明高效能、高可靠性的儲存解決方案如何滿足新一代智慧汽車日益成長的資料處理需求。
本場演講將於 8 月 4 日下午 2:20 在美國舉行，由慧榮 Edge SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德、聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed，以及慧榮科技企業級產品行銷資深協理 Shamil Sharief 共同主講，分享智慧儲存技術如何支援新一代 AI 車用平台、代理式 AI 與 AI 基礎設施的發展，並探討智慧儲存架構在未來 AI 應用中的關鍵角色。
慧榮指出，隨著車用產業邁入實體 AI 時代，智慧車輛已成為最具代表性的邊緣 AI 應用之一，所產生與處理的資料量正以前所未有的速度成長。憑藉超過十年的車用市場深耕，公司已成為車用產業值得信賴的儲存技術合作夥伴，持續提供兼具高效能、低功耗、高安全性與高可靠性的儲存解決方案，滿足新一代 AI 定義汽車 (AI-defined Vehicles) 的需求。
慧榮正透過與全球領先汽車 OEM、Tier 1 供應商、SoC 合作夥伴及 NAND Flash 大廠的緊密合作，公司儲存技術已廣泛應用於全球 AI 智慧座艙與車載運算平台。
慧榮科技邊緣 SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德表示，隨著 AI 工作負載日益趨向資料密集化，儲存架構已成為智慧系統效能的核心基礎，從 AI 定義汽車到 AI 工廠皆是如此。透過與聯發科的合作，將分享先進儲存架構如何提供智慧化資料管理、可預測的效能表現，以及新一代 AI 定義汽車所需的高可靠性。
聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed 表示，AI 正加速將汽車轉型為智慧運算平台，也對高效能、高可靠性的資料基礎架構提出全新要求。我們與慧榮科技的合作，充分展現先進運算與智慧儲存如何相輔相成，共同推動 AI-Ready 車輛的未來發展。
paras_en: Simo Technology (SIMO-US) announced today (31st) that it will join MediaTek (2454‑TW) for a keynote at FMS 2026, focusing on the next‑generation AI‑Ready automotive platform. The presentation will combine MediaTek’s latest in‑vehicle cockpit platform with Simo’s advanced automotive storage technology, illustrating how high‑performance, highly reliable storage solutions can meet the growing data‑processing demands of next‑generation smart cars.

The talk will be held on August 4 at 2:20 PM in the United States and will be co‑presented by Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide; MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed; and Simo’s Senior Associate Director of Enterprise Product Marketing, Shamil Sharief. They will discuss how intelligent storage technology supports next‑generation AI automotive platforms, agent‑based AI, and AI infrastructure development, and explore the critical role of smart storage architecture in future AI applications.

Simo notes that as the automotive industry enters the physical AI era, smart vehicles have become one of the most representative edge‑AI applications, with data generation and processing accelerating at unprecedented rates. With more than a decade of deep involvement in the automotive market, the company has become a trusted storage‑technology partner for the industry, continuously delivering solutions that combine high performance, low power, high security and high reliability to meet the needs of AI‑defined Vehicles.

Through close collaboration with global automotive OEMs, Tier‑1 suppliers, SoC partners and major NAND‑Flash manufacturers, Simo’s storage technology is now widely deployed in AI‑enabled cockpits and in‑vehicle compute platforms worldwide.

Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide, said that as AI workloads become increasingly data‑intensive, storage architecture has become the core foundation of smart‑system performance—from AI‑defined cars to AI factories. By partnering with MediaTek, they will share how advanced storage architectures provide intelligent data management, predictable performance, and the high reliability required by next‑generation AI‑defined vehicles.

MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed stated that AI is accelerating the transformation of cars into smart computing platforms, creating new demands for high‑performance, highly reliable data infrastructure. The collaboration with Simo demonstrates how advanced compute and intelligent storage complement each other to drive the future of AI‑Ready vehicles.

items.title: 再等恐付出更大代價！Fed反對票官員公開要求升息
items.title_en: Waiting Longer May Cost More! Fed Dissenters Publicly Call for Rate Hikes
paras: 本周反對聯準會 (Fed) 維持利率不變的 3 名官員周五 (31 日) 表示，現在就應採取升息行動，以防通膨進一步惡化，強調及早小幅調整政策，可避免日後被迫採取更激烈的緊縮措施。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 在聲明中表示，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 現在應該採取行動，加速個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數回到 2% 目標，履行維護物價穩定的承諾。她警告，通膨維持高檔的時間愈久，未來壓低通膨的難度與代價就愈高。
明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 也認為，現階段採取一連串小幅升息，會比持續等待、最終不得不祭出更大幅度行動來得理想。
卡什卡里與哈瑪克本周加入達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根 (Lorie Logan) 的行列，反對維持利率不變。FOMC 其餘 9 名具投票權官員則支持按兵不動，將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%。在 2025 年下半年連續降息 3 次後，Fed 今年以來始終未調整利率。
美國通膨超過 Fed 的 2% 目標已逾 5 年，今年又受到美伊戰爭及川普政府關稅政策影響而再度升溫。雖然中東緊張情勢短暫降溫，帶動 6 月物價漲勢放緩，但能源價格再度走高，市場擔心 Fed 最終仍須收緊貨幣政策。
Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 雖投票支持維持利率不變，但強調讓通膨回到目標的決心沒有動搖。他表示，長達 5 年多的通膨超標問題，不可能在 9 周內或僅憑單月物價小幅下降就獲得解決。
哈瑪克則直言，她沒有信心通膨會自行回落至目標。除了能源價格等供給面因素外，需求面也持續帶來物價壓力。克里夫蘭地區企業反映，漲價壓力正在擴大而非消退，消費者也對物價長期居高不下感到絕望。
卡什卡里表示，貨幣政策除了處理需求帶動的通膨，也應因應接連發生的供給衝擊，避免高通膨預期變得根深柢固。蘿根預計稍晚發表聲明，說明投下反對票的理由。
paras_en: Three Fed officials who voted against keeping rates unchanged this week said on Friday (the 31st) that the central bank should raise rates now to prevent inflation from worsening further, stressing that a modest early adjustment could avoid the need for more aggressive tightening later.

Beth Hammack, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, said in a statement that the Federal Open Market Committee should act now to accelerate the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index back toward its 2% target and fulfill its price‑stability mandate. She warned that the longer inflation stays high, the harder and more costly it will be to bring it down.

Neel Kashkari, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, also argued that a series of small rate hikes at this stage would be preferable to waiting and eventually being forced to take a larger‑scale action.

Kashkari and Hammack joined Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan this week in voting against holding rates steady. The other nine voting members of the FOMC supported keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.5%‑3.75%. After three consecutive cuts in the second half of 2025, the Fed has not changed rates at all this year.

U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% goal for more than five years and was reignited this year by the Israel‑Iran conflict and tariffs imposed by the Trump administration. Although Middle‑East tensions eased briefly, slowing June price gains, energy prices have risen again, prompting markets to worry that the Fed will ultimately have to tighten monetary policy.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who voted to keep rates unchanged, stressed that his resolve to bring inflation back to target remains firm. He said the more‑than‑five‑year period of elevated inflation cannot be solved in nine weeks or by a modest one‑month dip in prices.

Hammack said she lacks confidence that inflation will fall back to target on its own. In addition to supply‑side factors such as energy prices, demand‑side pressures continue to push prices up. Businesses in the Cleveland area report that price‑increase pressure is expanding rather than receding, and consumers are despairing over persistently high prices.

Kashkari added that monetary policy should address not only demand‑driven inflation but also the series of supply shocks, to prevent high‑inflation expectations from becoming entrenched. Logan is expected to issue a statement later explaining the reasons for her dissenting vote.

items.title: 特斯拉中國導入「豆包」大型語言模型 強化座艙在地化語音互動體驗
items.title_en: Tesla China Introduces ByteDance's "Doubao" Large Language Model to Enhance Localized In‑Cabin Voice Interaction
paras: 特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 中國 7 月 31 日公布了 2026.14.13 版本的車用軟體更新，涵蓋 Model 3、Model Y、Model S、Model X 車型，代表公司正式導入由字節跳動 (ByteDance) 開發的「豆包」大型語言模型 (LLM)。此舉被視為特斯拉強化中國市場在地化體驗、提升座艙競爭力的重要進展。
據指出，這項 AI 功能主要針對搭載 HW 3.0 或更早版本硬體的車型，而非最新的 AI4 硬體。此外，車主必須訂閱「高級車載娛樂服務」(Premium Connectivity)，目前在中國市場的訂閱費用為每月 9.99 元人民幣。
更新後的智慧語音助手不僅能提供即時資訊，還具備自然流暢的對話能力。特斯拉官方在社群媒體上指出，該助手具備唱歌、說故事及辯論等多元互動模式，並提供「萬事通」、「音樂愛好者」等多種個性化角色供選擇。
然而，現階段「豆包」助手僅限於資訊交互權限，相關助手目前尚無法直接控制車窗、空調等車輛硬體功能。當地評論人士認為，這體現了車企對行車安全的底線，車輛控制涉及核心操控安全，需經過更嚴苛的測試驗證，因此特斯拉採取了「引入本土模型補足互動短板，同時保留核心控制權」的折衷方案。
《CnEVPost》報導分析，中國本土電動車廠早已將 AI 語音助手視為標準配備，相比之下，特斯拉的座艙互動能力長期以來被視為弱點；此次合作是特斯拉推動座艙體驗在地化的實質性舉措。
對於字節跳動而言，這次合作意味著其大模型業務正式闖入「智慧座艙」這一黃金賽道。文章作者觀察到，字節跳動內部正透過整合「飛書」與「豆包」團隊，試圖打通 C 端消費場景與 B 端辦公應用，加速 AI 的商用落地。
除「豆包」外，特斯拉也曾披露與 DeepSeek 的合作，由後者負責 AI 閒聊功能。同時，報導指出阿里巴巴的「通義千問」(Qwen) 大型語言模型已進入深度測試階段，未來可能實現包括車輛控制與導航在內的更深層功能。
而在北美市場，特斯拉則持續使用由 Elon Musk 旗下 xAI 開發的 Grok 模型。這顯示特斯拉在全球不同市場採取了差異化的 AI 在地化策略，以應對各國語言與用戶習慣的挑戰。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) China announced on July 31 a vehicle‑software update (version 2026.14.13) covering Model 3, Model Y, Model S and Model X, marking the company’s formal adoption of ByteDance’s "Doubao" large language model (LLM). The move is seen as a key step for Tesla to strengthen its localized experience in the Chinese market and boost cabin competitiveness.

The AI feature is aimed at vehicles equipped with HW 3.0 or earlier hardware, not the newest AI4 hardware. Owners must subscribe to the Premium Connectivity service, which in China currently costs RMB 9.99 per month.

The upgraded smart voice assistant can provide real‑time information and engage in natural, fluid conversation. Tesla’s official social‑media post highlighted that the assistant can sing, tell stories, debate and offers multiple personalized personas such as "Jack‑of‑all‑trades" and "Music Lover" for users to choose from.

At present the "Doubao" assistant is limited to information‑exchange permissions and cannot directly control windows, climate or other vehicle hardware. Local commentators say this reflects automakers’ safety bottom line—vehicle control involves core safety functions that require stricter testing—so Tesla opted for a compromise: introduce a domestic model to fill interaction gaps while retaining core control rights.

According to CnEVPost, Chinese EV makers have long treated AI voice assistants as standard equipment, whereas Tesla’s cabin interaction has historically been viewed as a weakness; this partnership represents a substantive step toward localizing Tesla’s cabin experience.

For ByteDance, the deal signals its large‑model business entering the lucrative "smart cabin" arena. The article notes that ByteDance is integrating its Feishu and Doubao teams to bridge consumer (C‑end) scenarios with enterprise (B‑end) applications, accelerating commercial AI deployment.

In addition to Doubao, Tesla has disclosed a collaboration with DeepSeek, which handles AI chit‑chat functions. The report also mentions that Alibaba’s Qwen large language model is in deep‑testing phase and may later support deeper functions such as vehicle control and navigation.

In the North American market, Tesla continues to use the Grok model developed by Elon Musk’s xAI, illustrating Tesla’s differentiated AI localization strategy across regions to address language and user‑habit challenges.

items.title: Bloom Energy 進入爆發階段！看懂核心驅動力，才能掌握下一步
items.title_en: Bloom Energy Enters Explosive Growth Phase! Understanding the Core Drivers Is Key to the Next Step
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 自從 Bloom Energy (BE-US) 在 2024 年切入 AI 資料中心市場後，市場對公司未來訂單的預期幾乎全面翻轉。
根據 Visible Alpha 預估，Bloom Energy 的 100kW 燃料電池系統部署量，將由 2025 年約 4,477 套，大幅增加至 2030 年約 41,046 套，2032 年更進一步來到 45,027 套，七年間成長約 10 倍。
不過，這樣的預估也帶來一個值得思考的問題。
這樣一路向上的成長預期，沒有出現明顯的週期循環，是否合理？

Bloom Energy 的爆發關鍵
過去 Bloom Energy 主要提供企業、醫院、電信商及工廠等分散式發電系統，但真正讓市場重新認識它，是 AI 資料中心快速興建所帶來的新需求。
2024 年 7 月，公司宣布 CoreWeave 採用 Bloom Energy 作為 AI 資料中心現場供電方案，這也是他第一個公開的大型 AI 資料中心案例。
此後不到一年，便快速取得更多大型客戶，目前美國主要 Hyperscaler 幾乎都已完成方案驗證，AI 已成為公司最重要的新成長引擎。
從 S&P Global 最新預估來看，2025 年，美國 Hyperscale、租賃型及加密貨幣資料中心的電網用電需求已達約 64.4 GW，較前一年增加25%；到了2030年，預估將進一步增加至約 183.2 GW，五年間接近成長三倍。
然而，資料中心可以在一至兩年內完成規畫與建設，新的發電設施與輸電工程卻無法以相同速度上線。
即使美國聯邦能源管理委員會已透過 FERC Order 2023 推動併網改革，截至2026年，從專案進入排隊到預計商轉的平均時間，仍約為 53至59個月，相當於接近五年。部分壅塞較嚴重的市場，等待時間甚至更長。
也因此，越來越多資料中心開發商不再完全等待公用電網，而是採用「自帶電力」（Bring Your Own Power，BYOP）模式，直接在資料中心現場配置天然氣發電機組、燃料電池與儲能設備，以換取更快的上線時間。
簡單來說，Bloom Energy 受惠的核心，其實是 AI 資料中心帶來的供電缺口。

這樣的供電缺口會持續多久？
從 S&P Global 的併網（Interconnection Queue）資料，可以看到美國未來幾年的供電變化。
目前已知已簽署併網協議（IA）的併網排隊容量中，超過四分之三（約 225 GW）預計將於 2026 至 2028 年間投入商業運轉。
其中，2027 年預計有超過 84 GW 開始向電網送電，2028 年則預計再新增約 75 GW。
整體來看，預計在 2030 年前投入商業運轉的已簽約容量將超過 300 GW。
也就是說，目前 AI 建設最急迫的供電缺口，很可能集中在 2026 年。
隨著大量新電力於 2027～2028 年開始投入，供電壓力有機會逐步改善。

下一步：關注訂單性質的改變
備援電力需求本來就是 Bloom Energy 的長期驅動力，未來仍會占有一定比重。
2026 年資料中心建置需求最旺，同時也是新增電力尚未完全到位的關鍵時點，因此公司今年訂單強勁，沒有疑問。
不過，需要留意的是，後續需求的性質有沒有可能開始改變。
在目前供電最吃緊的階段，企業最重視的是盡快取得電力，因此現場發電設備屬於具有高度急迫性的建置需求。
但當大量新電力逐漸投入後，Bloom Energy 的角色，是否會從立即補足供電缺口，逐漸轉向提升供電韌性與備援能力，就是未來值得觀察的重點。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Since Bloom Energy (BE-US) entered the AI data‑center market in 2024, expectations for the company’s future orders have essentially flipped upside down.

According to Visible Alpha’s forecast, deployments of Bloom Energy’s 100 kW fuel‑cell systems will rise from about 4,477 units in 2025 to roughly 41,046 units by 2030, and further to 45,027 units in 2032 – an increase of about ten‑fold over seven years.
However, that forecast raises a question worth pondering: Is such a continuously upward growth expectation, without a clear cyclical pattern, reasonable?
Bloom Energy’s Explosive Trigger

Historically, Bloom Energy mainly supplied distributed power systems to enterprises, hospitals, telecom operators and factories, but the market’s renewed recognition of the company stems from the new demand generated by the rapid construction of AI data centers.

In July 2024, the company announced that CoreWeave would use Bloom Energy as the on‑site power solution for its AI data center – the first publicly disclosed large‑scale AI data‑center case for Bloom.
In less than a year, Bloom quickly secured more large customers; today, most major U.S. hyperscalers have completed solution validation, making AI the company’s most important new growth engine.

S&P Global’s latest estimate shows that in 2025 U.S. hyperscale, colocation and cryptocurrency data centers will demand about 64.4 GW of grid power, a 25% increase over the prior year; by 2030 the demand is projected to rise to roughly 183.2 GW, nearly tripling in five years.
Yet data‑center planning and construction can be completed within one to two years, while new generation facilities and transmission projects cannot be brought online at the same pace.

Even though the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has pushed interconnection reforms through FERC Order 2023, the average time from project queue entry to expected commercial operation remains about 53 to 59 months as of 2026 – roughly five years, with even longer waits in the most congested markets.

Consequently, an increasing number of data‑center developers are no longer waiting solely for the public grid; they are adopting a “Bring Your Own Power” (BYOP) model, installing on‑site natural‑gas generators, fuel cells and storage to achieve faster commissioning.
In short, the core benefit to Bloom Energy is the power‑supply gap created by AI data centers.
How Long Will This Power‑Supply Gap Last?
Interconnection queue data from S&P Global shows the upcoming changes in U.S. power supply.
Of the interconnection queue capacity already under signed interconnection agreements (IA), more than three‑quarters – about 225 GW – is slated to enter commercial operation between 2026 and 2028.
Specifically, over 84 GW is expected to start feeding the grid in 2027, with an additional roughly 75 GW in 2028.
Overall, signed capacity projected to be operational before 2030 will exceed 300 GW.
Thus, the most urgent power‑supply gap for AI construction is likely concentrated in 2026, with pressure expected to ease as large amounts of new power come online in 2027‑2028.
Next Step: Watch for Changes in Order Types
Backup power demand has always been a long‑term driver for Bloom Energy and will continue to represent a significant share of its business.
2026 is the peak year for data‑center build‑out and also the critical point when new power is not yet fully in place, so strong orders this year are unsurprising.
However, it is worth monitoring whether the nature of future demand will shift.
During the current tight‑supply phase, enterprises prioritize securing power quickly, making on‑site generation a highly urgent need.

When abundant new power gradually becomes available, the question will be whether Bloom Energy’s role transitions from immediately filling the power gap to enhancing power resilience and backup capability – a key trend to watch going forward.

items.title: SK海力士狂飆30%卻不是好事？南韓股市更大風暴恐在後頭
items.title_en: SK Hynix Soars 30%—But Is It a Bad Sign? A Bigger Storm May Loom for South Korea's Stock Market
paras: 《巴隆周刊》(Barron's)報導，SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 周五 (31 日) 在南韓股市狂飆 30%，三星電子也大漲 27%，帶動南韓綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 暴漲 18%。在資金重新湧入人工智慧 (AI) 概念股之際，這波強勁反彈雖讓投資人暫時鬆一口氣，但劇烈波動也暴露南韓股市的長期隱憂。
SK 海力士股價收在 171.8 萬韓元 (約 1,197 美元)。SK 海力士與三星電子兩大記憶體晶片巨頭聯袂大漲，成為推升 KOSPI 的主要動力。KOSPI 今年截至周五收盤累計上漲 57%，成為全球表現最強勁的股市，但上漲過程並不平穩。倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG) 資料顯示，KOSPI 過去十年來四次最大單日跌幅中，有三次發生在最近五周。
南韓散戶近來大舉押注 SK 海力士及其他科技股，並愈來愈常使用槓桿型 ETF 等高風險工具。這類 ETF 透過選擇權、交換合約及其他衍生性金融商品，放大標的每日漲跌幅；一旦市場下跌，投資人需要更大的反彈幅度才能回本，每日調整部位也可能侵蝕長期報酬。
市場原先期待，AI 類股近期下挫，加上南韓監管及政治壓力升高，能夠促使投資人降低槓桿並穩定市場。然而，SK 海力士與三星電子周五出現驚人漲幅，顯示南韓投資人手中仍有大量資金。若散戶再次透過槓桿型 ETF 追回先前虧損，恐為後續市場埋下更劇烈波動的風險。
不過，這不代表投資人應避開 SK 海力士美國存託憑證 (ADR)。該公司 ADR 周五盤前上漲 5.9%，報 158.07 美元，每 10 單位 ADR 代表一股南韓普通股。由於美國投資人需求龐大，加上 ADR 與普通股之間轉換存在障礙，SK 海力士 ADR 相較南韓股票享有明顯溢價。《巴隆周刊》先前仍看好其前景，認為相較美光 (MU-US)，SK 海力士是參與記憶體晶片榮景的另一項選擇。
此外，由 AI 避險基金 Situational Awareness 負責人阿申布倫納 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 管理的大部分股票投資組合已出售，可能減輕 SK 海力士 ADR 面臨的賣壓，為後續上漲騰出空間。
paras_en: Barron's reported that SK Hynix (SKHY-US) surged 30% on Friday (the 31st) in the South Korean market, while Samsung Electronics jumped 27%, driving the KOSPI index up an astonishing 18%. As capital rushes back into artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept stocks, this strong rebound gives investors a brief sigh of relief, but the extreme volatility also exposes long‑term concerns for South Korea’s equity market.

SK Hynix closed at 1.718 million won per share (about $1,197). The two memory‑chip giants, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, together powered the KOSPI’s rise. The index has risen 57% year‑to‑date as of Friday’s close, making it the best‑performing market globally, but the climb has been anything but smooth. Data from the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) show that three of the four biggest single‑day drops on the KOSPI in the past ten years have occurred in the last five weeks.

South Korean retail investors have recently placed large bets on SK Hynix and other tech stocks, increasingly using leveraged ETFs and other high‑risk tools. These ETFs amplify daily price moves through options, swaps and other derivatives; when the market falls, investors need an even larger rebound to break even, and daily position adjustments can erode long‑term returns.

The market had originally expected that a recent pullback in AI‑related stocks, combined with heightened regulatory and political pressure in South Korea, would force investors to cut leverage and stabilize the market. However, the startling gains by SK Hynix and Samsung on Friday show that a substantial amount of capital remains in the hands of South Korean investors. If retail traders again use leveraged ETFs to chase prior losses, they could sow the seeds for even more severe market swings.

That said, investors should not automatically avoid SK Hynix’s American Depositary Receipts (ADRs). The ADR rose 5.9% in pre‑market trading on Friday, reaching $158.07, with each 10‑ADR unit representing one ordinary share of the Korean stock. Because U.S. demand is strong and conversion between ADRs and the underlying Korean shares is not frictionless, SK Hynix ADRs trade at a noticeable premium to the domestic stock. Barron's has previously remained bullish on the company, viewing it as an alternative to Micron (MU-US) for participating in the memory‑chip boom.

In addition, most of the equity portfolio managed by AI‑hedge fund Situational Awareness’s head Leopold Aschenbrenner has been sold, which could ease selling pressure on SK Hynix ADRs and leave room for further upside.

items.title: 日元空頭小心了！日本傳一夜砸530億美元強勢護盤 規模恐創紀錄
items.title_en: Short Sellers of the Yen Beware! Japan Deploys $53 Billion Overnight to Strongly Support the Currency, Potentially Setting a Record Scale
paras: 日本政府昨日 (30 日) 可能斥資約 530 億美元進場干預匯市、支撐日元，規模有望創下東京當局單日干預的歷史新高，凸顯日本遏制投機性日元空單的決心，但也反映當局阻止日元貶值面臨愈來愈大的難度。
《彭博》根據日本銀行 (日本央行 / BOJ) 周五 (31 日) 公布的帳戶資料，以及貨幣市場經紀商的預測分析，日本此次干預金額估計約達 8.45 兆日元 (約 528 億美元)。日本官員尚未證實是否進場，但一名知情市場人士透露，日本確實採取行動支撐日圓，美國當局也在東京時間凌晨 2 時 30 分左右進行匯率詢價。
日元周四在紐約交易時段一度兌美元大漲 3.3%，創 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中升幅。市場另傳出日本與南韓可能協調干預匯市，《路透》報導，南韓也在紐約時段賣出美元，推動韓元一度升至去年 10 月中旬以來最高水準。
不過，日銀周五決議維持政策利率不變後，日元回吐部分漲幅，東京晚間交易時段報約 1 美元兌 159.95 日元。
日本財務省財務官三村淳拒絕證實是否干預，但暗示日本當局獲得包括美國在內的其他國家支持。若相關推估屬實，這將是日本自 4 月底黃金周期間以來首度進場干預。當時日本當局單月動用創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元，但財務省尚未公布各交易日的實際金額。
日銀周五公布的周一經常帳戶餘額預測顯示，受到財政因素影響，餘額預計減少 8.2 兆日元，與東京短資、中央短資及上田八木短資原先預估將增加的方向相反。日銀首次公布的經常帳戶餘額預測，通常被市場視為推算匯市干預規模最可靠的線索。
paras_en: The Japanese government may have spent about $53 billion yesterday (the 30th) to intervene in the foreign‑exchange market and support the yen, a scale that could set a new record for a single‑day intervention by Tokyo authorities. This underscores Japan’s determination to curb speculative short positions on the yen, but also highlights the growing difficulty of preventing yen depreciation.

According to Bloomberg, based on account data released by the Bank of Japan on Friday (the 31st) and forecasts from money‑market brokers, the amount of this intervention is estimated at roughly ¥8.45 trillion (about $52.8 billion). Japanese officials have not confirmed whether they entered the market, but a market source familiar with the matter said Japan did act to support the yen, and U.S. authorities also made a rate inquiry around 2:30 a.m. Tokyo time.

On Thursday, the yen surged 3.3% against the dollar during the New York trading session, the biggest intraday gain since December 2023. There were also reports that Japan and South Korea might coordinate FX interventions; Reuters said South Korea sold dollars during the New York session, pushing the won up to its highest level since mid‑October last year.
However, after the Bank of Japan left its policy rate unchanged on Friday, the yen gave back part of its gains, trading around ¥159.95 per dollar in the Tokyo evening session.

Japan’s Finance Ministry senior official Jun Mimura declined to confirm any intervention, but hinted that Japanese authorities have backing from other countries, including the United States. If the estimates are accurate, this would be Japan’s first intervention since the end of April’s “golden period,” when authorities used a record ¥11.73 trillion in a single month, though the ministry has not disclosed the exact daily amounts.

The BOJ’s forecast for the current‑account balance released on Friday shows an expected decline of ¥8.2 trillion due to fiscal factors, opposite to the earlier expectations of an increase from short‑term capital flows. The BOJ’s first‑time publication of a current‑account forecast is usually seen by the market as the most reliable clue for estimating the scale of FX interventions.

items.title: 日銀總裁釋放強烈鷹派訊號：對物價上行風險保持「前所未有」的警惕
items.title_en: BOJ Governor Sends Strong Hawkish Signal: Unprecedented Vigilance on Inflation Risks
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周五 (31 日) 表示，隨著基調物價上漲率逐步向 2% 的穩定目標靠攏，「物價上行風險」已成為政策制定的核心考量。他強調，過去物價距離目標尚遠時，預測誤差的代價不高，但在當前環境下，若通膨顯著超出預期，將對日本經濟產生嚴重的負面影響。
在周五的政策會議上，日銀以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，植田在會後重申潛在通膨率超過 2% 目標的風險，並強調了將通膨率維持在 2% 左右的重要性。
針對近期日元疲軟，植田表示，匯率波動對物價的影響力正在擴大，並將其與中東局勢、AI 相關需求並列為未來決策的關鍵分析因素。他強調日銀將努力避免陷入「落後於曲線」的困境，若經濟與物價走勢符合預期，且金融環境維持過度寬鬆，日銀極有可能加快升息步伐。

分析師解讀：9 月或 10 月升息機率上升

儘管日銀此次並未直接調整利率，但多數策略師將植田的發言解讀為具備「實質鷹派」色彩。
摩根大通策略師 Ikue Saito 指出，日銀上修了通膨展望，且植田提到下次會議將進行「深入討論」，這顯示 9 月升息的可能性依然存在。
伊藤忠總研的武田淳則認為，植田對物價風險的強調超乎預期，原本預計 12 月的追加升息時程極可能提前至 10 月。
雖然部分投資者因植田未給出具體的時間表而一度視其為「鴿派」，導致日元出現短暫賣壓，但 SMBC 日興證券的丸山凜途分析，植田反覆強調 2% 以上的上行風險，實際上展現了強烈的鷹派底色。
部分專家如 T&D 資產管理的浪岡優指出，日銀內部的政策共識似乎變得更加困難。儘管政府與日銀可能透過干預手段支撐日元，但若日銀被視為「不情願的升息者」，日元的貶值壓力恐將持續存在。
paras_en: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Friday (the 31st) that as the core inflation rate gradually moves toward the 2% stability target, the "inflation upside risk" has become a core consideration in policy making. He stressed that when inflation was far from the target, the cost of forecast errors was low, but in the current environment, a significant overshoot of inflation would have serious negative effects on the Japanese economy.

At Friday's policy meeting, the BOJ voted overwhelmingly 8‑to‑1 to keep the policy rate unchanged at 1.0%. After the meeting, Ueda reiterated the risk that underlying inflation could exceed the 2% target and emphasized the importance of keeping inflation around 2%.

Regarding the recent yen weakness, Ueda said that exchange‑rate fluctuations are increasingly influencing prices, and he listed the Middle‑East situation and AI‑related demand as key factors for future decision‑making. He stressed that the BOJ will work to avoid falling "behind the curve" and, if the economy and price trends align with expectations and the financial environment remains overly accommodative, the BOJ could accelerate rate hikes.
Analysts' take: Higher odds of a rate hike in September or October
Although the BOJ did not change rates this time, most strategists interpreted Ueda's remarks as having a "substantially hawkish" tone.

JPMorgan strategist Ikue Saito noted that the BOJ has upgraded its inflation outlook and that Ueda mentioned a "deep discussion" at the next meeting, indicating that a September hike remains possible.
Jun Takeda of Itochu Research believes Ueda's emphasis on price risks exceeds expectations and that the previously expected December additional hike could be moved up to October.

While some investors briefly saw Ueda as "dovish" because he gave no concrete timetable, causing short‑term selling pressure on the yen, SMBC Nikko Securities analyst Rinto Maruyama argues that Ueda's repeated emphasis on upside risks above 2% actually shows a strong hawkish undertone.

Experts such as Yu Nagasaka of T&D Asset Management point out that internal policy consensus at the BOJ appears to be becoming more difficult. Even if the government and the BOJ intervene to support the yen, if the BOJ is seen as a "reluctant rate‑raiser," depreciation pressure on the yen is likely to persist.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙漲！強升1.62角收32.292元 單月仍狂貶4.55角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Both Rise! Strong Jump of 1.62 ¢ to 32.292, Still Down 4.55 ¢ for the Month
paras: 美股 30 日全面大漲，帶動亞洲股匯今 (31) 日報復性反彈，台股飆漲逾 3000 點，新台幣兌美元升幅逐漸擴大，終場強升 1.62 角或 0.5%，創逾 3 個月以來單日最大升幅，收在 32.292 元，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值放大至 40.49 億美元。
新台幣兌美元匯率今天強勢走升，一口氣衝破 32.4、32.3 元兩道關卡，收在 32.292 元，本周累計升值 6.6 分或 0.2%，中止連五周收黑；7 月累計仍狂貶 4.55 角或 1.4%，月線寫下連二黑。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數大跌 0.87%，主要亞幣展開強勁的反彈攻勢，其中，日元狂飆 2.2% 最猛，新加坡幣勁揚 0.71%，韓元升值 0.64%，新台幣亦強升 0.50%，人民幣升值 0.14%。
台北股匯今日上演報復性反彈，台積電罕見攻上漲停，達到 2425 元，上漲 220 元，創史上最大漲點，帶動台股大漲 3186.45 點，收在 43119.75 點，同創史上最大漲點紀錄。
paras_en: U.S. stocks surged across the board on the 30th, driving a retaliatory rebound in Asian equities and currencies on the 31st. The Taiwan stock index jumped over 3,000 points, and the New Taiwan dollar (NTD) against the U.S. dollar continued to appreciate, ending the day up 1.62 ¢ (about 0.5%), the largest single‑day gain in more than three months, closing at 32.292 NTD. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets expanded to USD 4.049 billion.

The NTD/USD rate rose strongly today, breaking through the 32.4 and 32.3 NTD thresholds and closing at 32.292 NTD. For the week, the currency appreciated a cumulative 6.6 ¢ (0.2%), ending a five‑week streak of declines. However, for July it is still down a sharp 4.55 ¢ (1.4%), marking the second consecutive negative day for the month.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar, the central bank’s data show the U.S. dollar index fell 0.87%, while key Asian currencies staged strong rebound attacks. The Japanese yen surged the most at 2.2%, the Singapore dollar rose 0.71%, the Korean won gained 0.64%, the New Taiwan dollar strengthened 0.50%, and the Chinese yuan appreciated 0.14%.

Taipei’s stock and currency markets staged a retaliatory rebound today. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) unusually hit its daily price‑limit ceiling at 2,425 NTD, up 220 NTD, the biggest point gain in its history, propelling the Taiwan index up 3,186.45 points to close at 43,119.75 points, tying the record for the largest single‑day rise.

items.title: 日本央行維持利率不變 下修通膨預期但保留後續升息空間
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged, Lowers Inflation Forecast but Leaves Room for Future Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行在周五 (31 日) 的金融政策決定會議上，以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，此舉反映出日銀在 6 月升息後，傾向於觀察其對經濟與物價情勢的影響，並對中東衝突與日元匯率保持謹慎態度。
受周五決定的影響，日元走弱，美元兌日元匯率上漲 0.7%。
在本次會議中，審議委員高田創是唯一的反對者。他提議將利率提高至 1.25% 左右，認為隨著海外金融政策轉向及國內物價上行風險增加，日本已進入需要機動調整政策的「新階段」，但此案最終被多數否決。
根據日銀同步發布的「經濟與物價情勢展望報告」，政策委員將 2026 年度實質國內總生產 (GDP) 人工智慧 (AI) 相關需求的增加，以及政府補助政策對國內消費的支撐。
在物價方面，2026 年度的核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 預測則從原先的 2.8% 下修至 2.5%。這主要是受到東京政府實施公用事業補貼的影響，短期內減緩了通膨壓力。然而，日銀指出，隨著薪資與物價良性循環的維持，基調物價預計在 2026 年底至 2027 年度趨於 2% 的目標水準。
儘管本次維持利率不變，日銀強調若經濟與物價展望如期實現，將繼續提高政策利率，以調整金融寬鬆程度。日銀特別提到，日元貶值及 AI 帶動的半導體價格上漲，仍可能導致物價「上行風險」大於下行風險，甚至有超越 2% 目標的可能性。
市場分析師對此持鷹派解讀，凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 分析指出，日銀的評論暗示後續仍有升息可能，預測下一次行動可能落在 10 月，且利率有望在明年底達到 2%。日銀未來將密切關注中東局勢、匯率波動及 AI 產業動向，做為調整政策節奏的依據。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan decided to keep its policy interest rate unchanged at 1.0% with an overwhelming majority of 8 to 1 at its monetary policy meeting on Friday, reflecting its intention to observe the impact of its previous rate hike in June on the economy and prices, and to remain cautious about the Middle East conflict and yen exchange rate.
The decision led to a weakening of the yen, with the dollar-yen exchange rate rising 0.7% on Friday.

The only dissenter in the meeting was committee member Takashi Kadota, who proposed raising the interest rate to around 1.25%, citing the need for flexible policy adjustments as Japan enters a 'new phase' with increasing risks of higher prices at home and a shift in overseas monetary policies, but his proposal was rejected by the majority.

According to the 'Economic and Price Outlook' report released by the Bank of Japan at the same time, policymakers expect the increase in demand related to artificial intelligence (AI) and government subsidy policies to support domestic consumption in the 2026 fiscal year.

In terms of prices, the forecast for the core consumer price index (CPI) in the 2026 fiscal year was revised down from 2.8% to 2.5%, mainly due to the impact of the Tokyo government's implementation of public utility subsidies, which has eased inflationary pressure in the short term. However, the Bank of Japan pointed out that with the maintenance of a virtuous cycle of wages and prices, the underlying inflation rate is expected to approach the 2% target level by the end of 2026 to 2027.

Although the interest rate was left unchanged this time, the Bank of Japan emphasized that if the economic and price outlook is as expected, it will continue to raise policy interest rates to adjust the degree of monetary easing. The Bank of Japan particularly noted that the depreciation of the yen and the rise in semiconductor prices driven by AI may still lead to 'upside risks' to prices, even exceeding the 2% target.

Market analysts took a hawkish view of this, with Capital Economics analysts pointing out that the Bank of Japan's comments suggest that there is still a possibility of further rate hikes, predicting that the next action may come in October, and that interest rates are expected to reach 2% by the end of next year. The Bank of Japan will closely watch the situation in the Middle East, exchange rate fluctuations, and trends in the AI industry as the basis for adjusting the pace of policy.

items.title: 日元狂升500點是假反轉？美日匯市角力透露下一波行情關鍵
items.title_en: Is the 500-Point Surge in the Yen a False Reversal? The Struggle in the US-Japan Forex Market Reveals the Key to the Next Trend
paras: 就在日本央行週五 (31 日) 公布利率決議前夕，日元匯率出現劇烈反彈。市場消息顯示，日本當局可能在週四紐約交易時段再次出手干預外匯市場，而這次行動疑似獲得美國方面支持。
週四紐約交易時段，日元 / 美元 (JPYUSD) 一度急升逾 500 點，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中漲幅。根據日本當地知情人士透露，此次干預目的在於提振日元匯率；與此同時，美國當局於東京時間凌晨 2 點 30 分左右進行「匯率詢價」（rate checks），此舉通常被市場視為美方可能準備介入匯市的前兆訊號。
市場人士認為，美方的相關行動提升了此次日本干預的市場影響力，也可能促使交易員在操作日元時更加謹慎。
美國財政部長斯貝森特週四受訪時表示，他認為日元「似乎被嚴重低估」，並指出匯率「過度波動」並不健康。
日本最高外匯官員三村淳週五被問及是否實施匯市干預時，並未正面回應，但表示日本從美國獲得的不僅僅是道義上的支持。
利率決議前夕精準狙擊
分析人士指出，日本此次選擇在日本央行貨幣政策會議前出手，可能是為了提高干預效果，並藉由突襲方式降低市場預期。
SMBC 日興證券高級外匯與利率策略師丸山凜斗（Rinto Maruyama）表示，在日本央行會議前進行干預，與今年 4 月較透明、容易被市場察覺的干預方式形成明顯差異。
他指出，近期日美兩國長期債券殖利率急升，是日本外匯干預以及美國匯率詢價行動背後的重要因素。另有分析認為，聯準會決議後美元指數意外走弱，也為日本當局進場干預創造較有利環境。
日元雖急升 貶值壓力仍未解除
在此次行情中，美元兌日元匯率一度跌至 157.98，亞洲時段最新交投約 160.67 附近。不過，儘管日元短線大幅反彈，過去 12 個月來日元兌美元仍累計貶值約 6%，在 G10 貨幣中表現墊底。
日本財務大臣片山皋月面對媒體詢問時表示，目前無法透露是否進行匯市干預，但重申當局持續保持高度警戒，隨時準備採取應對措施。
近幾個月來，日元持續承受貶值壓力，主要受到油價上漲、財政赤字，以及日美利率差擴大的影響。儘管日本當局上一季已在公開市場投入創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元（約 734 億美元）買入日元，但匯率仍持續走弱。
動用巨額資金救日元 挑戰全球匯市力量
根據日本財務省外匯儲備資料，日本先前可能動用了持有的外國證券，包括美國國債，作為干預匯市的資金來源。
這筆史無前例的資金規模，不僅凸顯日本面臨的匯率壓力，也反映出在全球每日交易規模達 9.5 兆美元的外匯市場中，單一國家想逆轉市場趨勢的難度。
利差問題未解 日元長線仍面臨考驗
日本自 2022 年重新重返外匯市場支撐日元後，並於 2024 年再次出手，試圖減緩日元兌美元貶值速度。日元長期走弱，主要源於全球央行在疫情後通膨升溫期間陸續升息，但日本央行長期維持負利率政策，以刺激經濟成長。
此次日元異動正值日本央行政策決議前夕，市場原先預期日本央行在上月升息後，將暫時維持利率不變。上月升息後，日本基準利率已升至 1995 年以來最高水準，投資人此前擔憂日本央行在應對通膨方面反應落後。
此外，儘管聯準會本週維持利率不變，市場仍預期今年稍晚可能降息，日美利率差距短期內仍可能維持對日元不利的格局。
對於此次干預效果，三井住友信託銀行紐約交易員山本武尊（Takeru Yamamoto）表示，當局此時出手可能讓外匯投資人重新評估風險，暫時降低拋售日元的意願。
paras_en: Just before the Bank of Japan's interest rate decision on Friday, the yen exchange rate experienced a sharp rebound. Market news showed that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market again during the New York trading session on Thursday, and this action was suspected to have been supported by the US side.

During the New York trading session on Thursday, the yen/dollar (JPYUSD) once surged by more than 500 points, creating the largest intraday gain since December 2023. According to local informed sources in Japan, the purpose of this intervention was to boost the yen exchange rate; meanwhile, the US authorities conducted 'rate checks' around 2:30 am Tokyo time, which is usually seen by the market as a sign that the US may be preparing to intervene in the forex market.

Market participants believe that the US side's related actions have enhanced the market impact of Japan's intervention and may have prompted traders to be more cautious when operating the yen. US Treasury Secretary Spencent said in an interview on Thursday that he thought the yen was 'severely undervalued' and pointed out that excessive exchange rate fluctuations are unhealthy.

Japan's top foreign exchange official, Michinori Mochizuki, was asked on Friday whether forex intervention was implemented, but did not respond directly, saying that Japan had received more than just moral support from the US.

Analysts pointed out that Japan's choice to intervene before the Bank of Japan's monetary policy meeting may have been to increase the effectiveness of the intervention and reduce market expectations through a surprise attack.

Rinto Maruyama, senior forex and rates strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, said that intervening before the Bank of Japan meeting was significantly different from the more transparent intervention method in April, which was easier for the market to detect.

He pointed out that the recent surge in long-term bond yields in Japan and the US was an important factor behind Japan's forex intervention and the US's rate check action. Another analysis suggested that the unexpected weakness in the US dollar index after the Fed's decision also created a more favorable environment for Japan's intervention.

Although the yen surged, the downward pressure on the currency has not been alleviated. In this trend, the dollar/yen exchange rate once fell to 157.98 and was recently trading around 160.67 in the Asian session. However, despite the yen's short-term sharp rebound, it has accumulated a depreciation of about 6% against the US dollar over the past 12 months, ranking last among G10 currencies.

Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima said when facing media inquiries that he could not disclose whether forex intervention was conducted, but reiterated that the authorities remain highly vigilant and are ready to take countermeasures at any time.

In recent months, the yen has continued to face downward pressure, mainly due to rising oil prices, fiscal deficits, and the widening interest rate differential between Japan and the US. Although the Japanese authorities invested a record 1.173 trillion yen (approximately $7.34 billion) in the open market to buy yen last quarter, the exchange rate continued to weaken.

Using huge funds to save the yen challenges the global forex market's strength. According to the Japanese Ministry of Finance's foreign exchange reserve data, Japan may have used its holdings of foreign securities, including US Treasury bonds, as a funding source for intervening in the forex market.

This unprecedented scale of funds not only highlights the exchange rate pressure Japan faces but also reflects the difficulty for a single country to reverse market trends in the global forex market, where daily trading volume reaches $9.5 trillion.

The interest rate differential problem has not been resolved, and the yen still faces a long-term test. Japan has been back in the forex market to support the yen since 2022 and intervened again in 2024 to slow down the yen's depreciation against the US dollar. The yen's long-term weakness mainly stems from global central banks' rate hikes during the post-pandemic inflation period, while the Bank of Japan has maintained a negative interest rate policy to stimulate economic growth.

This yen fluctuation occurred just before the Bank of Japan's policy decision, and the market had initially expected the Bank of Japan to maintain interest rates unchanged after last month's rate hike. After the rate hike last month, Japan's benchmark interest rate has risen to its highest level since 1995, and investors had previously been concerned that the Bank of Japan was lagging behind in responding to inflation.

Additionally, although the Fed maintained interest rates this week, the market still expects a possible rate cut later this year, and the Japan-US interest rate differential may continue to be unfavorable to the yen in the short term.

Regarding the effect of this intervention, Takeru Yamamoto, a New York trader at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said that the authorities' intervention at this time may have prompted forex investors to reevaluate risks and temporarily reduced their willingness to sell the yen.

paras: 韓元兌美元匯率今 (31) 日早盤一度升值至九個月高點，此前首爾外匯當局疑似實施了匯率維穩操作。
首爾時間上午 6 點左右，韓元兌美元升值至 1418 韓元，創 2025 年 10 月 20 日以來的最高水準。截至當地時間今日上午 9 時 37 分，韓元兌美元報 1430 韓元。
韓元的升值與日元的上漲同步。在週四 (30 日) 紐約交易時段，日元兌美元匯率一度升值 3.3%，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來的最大盤中升幅紀錄。對此市場普遍猜測日本當局出手干預。
首爾 KB 國民銀行分析師 Lee Min-hyuk 表示，韓元與日元之間的相關性引發了外界猜測，兩國外匯監管機構可能已介入市場。
他並推測說：「韓元和日元隔夜走強「恐顯示韓日當局可能已共同干預」。
市場正屏息等待日本央行 (BOJ) 決議，總裁植田和男的記者會將決定日元這輪反彈是趨勢反轉，還是短暫脈衝。BOJ 預計維持政策利率在 1% 不變，決議可能獲得政策委員會廣泛多數支持。BOJ 也將發布季度展望報告，包含更新的經濟成長和通膨率估值，而受到日本國內活動韌性和 AI 相關投資的強勁需求支撐，決策官員可能上調日本成長預期，
日元大漲後，日本政府不願證實是否在隔夜交易期間干預匯市，但暗示得到了美國官員等海外同行的支持。
日本財務大臣片山皋月今日迴避日元飆升是否是干預結果的問題，僅稱將「保持高度警惕，並採取適當措施」。
隨後不久，日本外匯事務負責人三村淳暗示，一直得到美國同行和其他國家的支持。
三村淳說，「確實意識到，我們從美國獲得的支持不僅僅是道德上的支持」，並稱已透過個人管道與美國當局保持密切聯繫，但拒絕透露更多細節。
paras_en: The South Korean won (KRW) appreciated to a nine-month high against the US dollar in early trading today, following suspected intervention by Seoul's foreign exchange authorities. The won rose to 1,418 KRW per USD around 6:00 am local time, its highest level since October 20, 2025, and was trading at 1,430 KRW per USD as of 9:37 am local time.

The won's gain was synchronized with the yen's (JPY) surge. In Thursday's New York trading session, the yen appreciated 3.3% against the USD, marking its largest intraday gain since December 2023, sparking speculation about potential intervention by Japanese authorities.

Lee Min-hyuk, an analyst at KB Kookmin Bank in Seoul, stated that the correlation between the won and the yen has led to speculation about possible intervention by the foreign exchange authorities of both countries. He further speculated that the overnight strength of the won and the yen might indicate joint intervention by South Korean and Japanese authorities.

The market is eagerly awaiting the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) decision, with Governor Kazuo Ueda's press conference set to determine whether the yen's rebound is a trend reversal or a short-term pulse. The BOJ is expected to maintain its policy rate at 1%, with the decision likely to receive broad support from the policy committee. The BOJ will also release its quarterly outlook report, including updated estimates for economic growth and inflation, which may be revised upward due to strong domestic demand and AI-related investments.

Following the yen's significant surge, the Japanese government declined to confirm whether it had intervened in the currency market during overnight trading but hinted at receiving support from US officials and other overseas counterparts. Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima avoided commenting on whether the yen's surge was a result of intervention, stating only that the government would 'remain highly vigilant and take appropriate measures'.

Soon after, Japan's foreign exchange chief, Junichi Suzuki, suggested that the country had received support from the US and other nations. Suzuki stated, 'We are aware that the support we receive from the US is not just moral support', and mentioned that Japan had maintained close contact with US authorities through personal channels, but refused to disclose further details.

paras: 美元周四 (30 日) 下跌，交易員對聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 強調抗通膨立場持懷疑態度。同時，日元大幅升值，創下 2022 年以來最大單日漲幅。分析認為，這波走勢看起來像是日本政府正式介入外匯市場。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 1%，報 99.89，寫下 4 月 21 日以來最差單日表現。
截至發稿，尚未確認日本當局是否進場交易，但日元如此大幅波動，加上銀行回報外匯交易量明顯高於平常，都顯示可能存在官方干預。
美元兌日元一度下跌 3%，至 158.34 日元，低於本周稍早創下的近 164 日元、40 年高點。
日本央行 (BoJ) 將於周五公布最新利率決策。周三美國聯準會維持利率不變，但美元受到打擊，因交易員開始質疑聯準會新任主席是否真的會積極遏制通膨。
三菱 UFJ 摩根士丹利證券外匯策略師 Daisaku Ueno 表示，「很難想像，除了外匯干預外，還有什麼因素能讓日元在如此短的時間內升值 5 日元。」
「如果這確實是一次干預，許多市場參與者原本預期干預會發生在 FOMC 與日本央行會議之後，因此當局可能有意讓市場措手不及。」
外匯交易量也同步大幅增加。花旗銷售與交易部門在給機構客戶的報告中指出，美東時間上午 9:30 至 9:40 期間，其電子交易平台估計在主要外匯交易市場有約 81 億美元的美元兌日元賣單。
花旗表示，「干預看起來是合理可能的解釋。」
日元兌歐元與英鎊同步升值逾 2%，兌澳幣則升值近 2%。
債市未完全信服華許立場
投資人持續消化聯準會周三決定維持利率不變的影響，目前市場焦點更多放在華許會後記者會上的談話。
雖然聯準會維持利率不變大致符合市場預期，但由於油價劇烈波動引發通膨環境快速變化，市場對升息的預期高於近期歷史水準。
華許在會後記者會上表示，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 內部經歷了一場「良好的家庭辯論」，進行了「積極且充分的討論」，主要圍繞四個議題：持續存在的通膨問題、近期經濟衝擊及由這些衝擊帶來的價格壓力，以及貨幣政策工具。
華許也表示，三位地方聯準銀行總裁的反對票「並未完全反映整場討論的本質」，而 6 月通膨數據走弱對此次利率決策影響「並不大」。
麥格理外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「我們從記者會中得到幾項觀察或推論。其中一點是，華許正刻意延後提高聯準會政策利率，並以言論取代實際行動，同時試圖掩蓋或轉移他本質上偏鴿派的立場。」
在聯準會決策與華許談話公布後，周三美債殖利率走勢出現分化：長天期殖利率上升，但較短天期、對利率政策更敏感的殖利率則下滑。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 30th) as traders expressed skepticism toward Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's emphasis on an anti‑inflation stance. At the same time, the yen rallied sharply, posting its biggest one‑day gain since 2022. Analysts said the move looks like a formal intervention by the Japanese government in the foreign‑exchange market.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, dropped 1% to 99.89, marking its worst single‑day performance since April 21.

At the time of writing, it has not been confirmed whether Japanese authorities entered the market, but the yen’s extreme volatility, combined with bank‑reported FX trading volumes clearly above normal, suggests possible official intervention.
The dollar‑yen pair fell as much as 3% to ¥158.34, below the near‑¥164 level—a 40‑year high—set earlier this week.

The Bank of Japan will announce its latest rate decision on Friday. The Fed kept rates unchanged on Wednesday, but the dollar was hit as traders began to doubt whether the new Fed chair would aggressively curb inflation.
Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley FX strategist Daisaku Ueno said, "It's hard to imagine any factor other than FX intervention that could push the yen up by five yen in such a short time."
"If this is indeed an intervention, many market participants had expected it to occur after the FOMC and BoJ meetings, so the authorities may have deliberately caught the market off‑guard," he added.

FX trading volume also surged. Citi’s sales and trading division noted in a report to institutional clients that between 9:30 a.m. and 9:40 a.m. ET, its electronic platform estimated about $8.1 billion of dollar‑yen sell orders in the major FX market.
Citi said, "Intervention looks like a plausible explanation."
The yen also appreciated over 2% against the euro and the pound, and rose nearly 2% against the Australian dollar.
Bond market not fully convinced by Warsh’s stance
Investors continue to digest the impact of the Fed’s Wednesday decision to keep rates steady, with market focus now shifting to Warsh’s remarks at the post‑meeting press conference.

Although the Fed’s hold was broadly in line with expectations, the rapid swing in oil prices has sparked a quickly changing inflation environment, leaving rate‑hike expectations above recent historical levels.

Warsh said after the press conference that the Federal Open Market Committee had a "good family debate" with "vigorous and thorough discussion," focusing on four topics: persistent inflation, recent economic shocks and the price pressures they generate, and monetary‑policy tools.

He also noted that the three regional Fed bank presidents’ dissenting votes "did not fully reflect the nature of the discussion," and that the weaker June inflation data had "little impact" on the rate decision.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman observed, "We gleaned several observations from the press conference. One is that Warsh is deliberately postponing a Fed policy‑rate hike, using rhetoric instead of action, while trying to mask or shift his fundamentally dovish stance."
After the Fed decision and Warsh’s remarks were released, U.S. Treasury yields diverged on Wednesday: long‑term yields rose, while shorter‑term, policy‑sensitive yields fell.
That trend continued on Thursday. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose more than 4 basis points to 4.666%, while the 2‑year yield slipped slightly to 4.234%.
